༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ mu kha ā ga ma/ bod skad du/ zhal kyi lung / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan ral gri las byung gur gum mdog /zhi ba'i zhal gsum phyag ni drug ldan zhing / /shes rab kyis 'khyud chu skyes la bzhugs sapa'i/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rim pa'i gzhung lugs kyi/ /sgrub thabs bdag nyid dran phyir brtsam par bya/ /'jam dbyangs bde bar rtogs pa'i don du ni/ /rtogs — pa'i nga rgyal bde ba dang bral ba/ /sgra yi tshogs kyi sdeb spyor bral dgongs pa/ /sbas rnams slob dpon zhabs kyis 'gro don du/ /gsal bar sgra ji bzhin du bshad don duzi/ /sdeb sbyor yangs shing mtshan nyid dang bral zhing / /gang yang don zab tshad mas shin tu sbas/ /blo dman rnams kyis de rtogs mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dpal ldan ye shes zhal bshad sgrub 21—872

'joms byed pa/ /rnam thar rnam gsum gyi sgo dag par 'gyur/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā zhes dang por rnam par thar/ /gzhan ni a ni mit+ta 3zhes su bshad/ /oṃ a pra ṇi bye ༄ tai sgra de rnams/ /'dir bdag ye shes la sogs zhal gsum 'dod/ /des ni lha mi'i dag pa thob gyur nas/ /de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong / /sna tshogs gzhal yas khang byas dbus gnas pa'i/ /bla ma mgon po nam mkha' la gnas mchod/ /snying po'i sa bon gyis spros 'od zer tshogs / /las byung gzugs sogs dgu po'i bdag nyid dang / /me tog la sogs phyi rol rang gi mgon/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyis mchod bsam / /rdzogs sangs 'khor lo'i spyan sngar sa la ni/ /pus btsugs dman pa'i sems kyis thal sbyar byas/ /dkyil 'khor mgon po mchod pas rab mchod cing / /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs brjod par bya/ /bdag gi phyelus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /chags dang zhe sdang rnam par rmongs byu pa yis/ /srid pa nyam nga rnams su sdig bgyis pa/ /des na sdig de thams cad rab tu bshags / /sdog pa bshags pa'o/ /sngon chad byas pa'i sdig pa bshags nas kyang / /slar yang de la 'jug par mi bgyid cing / /byang chub snying po la gnas gyur gyi bar/ /rtag tu bdag gi bsod nams blo ldan shog /sdom pa'o//rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' mchog /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang bgyis pa/ /de la'ang bdag ni byang chub 'bras thob par/ /ma lus pa la bdag ni rjes yi rang / /rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /legs par gsungs chus bran pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /myug ni bdag gis rim thob thu'aphel ba yis/ /'khor ba'i gdung bas bcom pa'i 'go rnams la/ /yang dag byang 21—874

chub shing mchog ①'bras bcas 'gyur/ /yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /rdzogs sangs rin chen rang gi sems gnas dang / /rtog pa'i dra ba rab tu rnam bral chos/ /sa dbang tshogs ⑪dang brtul zhugs dbang dge 'dun/ /rab tu dad pas rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /gsum la skyabs su mchi ba'o/ /sdug bsngal tshogs kyis bsregs pa'i sems can kun/ /snying rje ldan las rngubyung kun gtong ba ni/ /dam chos chu char rab bsregs 'joms pa yis 4/ /sangs rgyas sgrub ces rang sems bskyed par bya/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /sbyin pa la sogs bya bas skabs byas te/ /'das pa'i rgyal ba'i sras rnams kun gyi lam/ /gshegs dang gshegs 'gyur 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dpal 'bras lam mchog de la brten ⑤par bgyi/ /lam la brten pa'o/ /rgyal dang bdag nyid las du skyes de rnams la/ /kun nas kun du bdag nyid bdag gis dbul/ /sems dpa' klumachog gis bdag nyid yongs gzung drubs/ /dad pas khyod byel 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag nyid dbul ba'o/ /glo bur nyon mongs tshogs chen gyis gdungs pa/ /bskyod ⑩pa'i skye bo mtha' med dgrol ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi sngags rnams bshad pa ru/ /sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag bskul lo/ /bskul ba'o/ /mchog tu mi dge bsam pas rab bcom pa'i /bdud kyi skye rga na dang 'chi ba las/ /mya ngan 'das bzhed gyur pa spangs nas su//mgon mchog bzhugs par bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba gdab pa'o//tshigs bcad rdzogs byas legs zhes brjod nas ni/ /thub dbang tshogs rnams de nas mi snang gyur/ /rtsu bsgoms nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /nam mkha' a dza na ⑪ri'i mdog ldan pa/ /de byung sna tshogs rdo rje munyi dkyil gnas//21—875

de las gtso bo'i sa bon 'od ldan pa/ /de las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sprin tshogs kyis//phyogs rnams thams cad char gyis yongs su gang / /de las phyogs brgyad rdo rje'i turang bzhin char/ /rab 'bab de yis dra bar sprul par dudamigs/ /des ni sa bdun 'og la sogs 'phel nas/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du mda' rnams so/ /steng gi sa bon gyur pas skad cig la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje yi ni bla re byung / /'od zer de tshogs mda' dang 'dra ba yis/ /nam mkha' khyab par kun du gdugs su gyur/ /yi las byung ba'i rlung ni 'og tu bsam/ /gzhur byas 'od sngon rgyal mtshan gyis ni mtshan/ /bye du ram pa zhes bya ba dum bu min / /'gro ba'i snying po 'dzin 'gyur gzhag par bya/ /dbus su gru gsum 'bar ba rab 'bar ba4/ /ram̐ gyi sa bon las byung phyogs gzhu 'dren/ /mthong nas de yi dbus su mtshams bcing bya/ /baṃ dkar las byung ba yi bum mtshan chu/ /de dbus lo las byung ba'i mdog ser po/ /ra ba'i don du gru bzhi dbang gi'o/ //hūṃ gis sna tshogs rdo rje byas sa phyogs/ /de dbus ra bar rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ /'di ni zhing rnams 3 rnam par dag pa'o/ /hūṃ pya ser las byung 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i/ /rtse mo'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spro bar bya//rtsibs rnams thams cad kyi ni lte ba'i phyogs/ /paṃ byung pad+ma'i steng du re ④ skyes nyi/ /legs gsungs rgyal ba rnams kyi skyed byed yum/ /r+ghaṃ 4byung ye shes rnams ni gang yin nyid/ /sdug bsngal la sogs bcu gcig rnams kyi phyir/ /nyi ma nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ dgod bya/ /ye shes bcu gcig bcas 'dir 'khor lo la//nyi ma la gnas t+t+waṃ byung rdo rje sngo/ /lte ba'i pad+ma nyid byung rdo rje las/ /dpal ldan rdo rje hūṃ mdzad sku ru gyur/ /yan lag kun ni dbu ma'i zhal dang 'dra/ /21—876

g.yas pa dkar zhing g.yon pa'i zhal yang dmar/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i phyag drug 'jigs pa'i spyan/ /'jigs pa'i bskal pa'i sprin 'dra sgra sgrogs pa/ /rig ma kun du bzang mos yang dag 'khyud/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni yan lag yongs su sdom hūṃ/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa dang / /zhags pa lcags kyu lag pa g.yon gnyis 'dzin/ /g.yas pas u ma'i nu ma'i dkyil mnan cing / /g.yon pas bde 'byung dregs pa'i mgo bo gnon/ /de bzhin zhabs kyi g.yas brkyang bzlog pa yis/ /gnas pa'i mgon po sku ni rab tu sgeg /rtsibs re re la nyi ma bcu gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ byung mtshan ma 'dzin pa spro bar bya/ /bsdus nas 3tho ba dbyug pa pad+ma dang / /rdo rje de rnams dbang sogs phyogs gnas bskyed/ /bskor zhuphyogs su ni be+egs kyu dbyug pa mdung / /rdo rje me la sogs pa'i mtshams su bskyed/ /'khor lo dgra sta gnyis ni steng 'og tu/ /skyed par byed de khro bo'i zhal ljang dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed gzhan gyis mi thub dang / /rta gdong bgegs kyi tshogs ni rnam par 'joms/ /ṭak+ki dbyig sngon dang ni stobs po che/ /khro bo mi g.yo gtsug tor 3gnod mdzes rgyal/ /gnyis ni dkar po rta ༄ dāgadong dmar po ste/ /de bzhin gtsug tor 'khor los 7sgyur ser po/ /bdun po gzhan dag kyang ni shin tu sngo/ /kun kyang nyi ma'i dkyil gnas rab tu grags3/ /g.yas pa'i pus mo'i tshigs ni shin tu bskums9//g.yon pa'i brla dang rje ngar gnyis rab brkyang / /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du gnas—/ /phyogs dbang lus ni ji lta ba bzhin mnan/ / be+e ta ji tī 4 snakhro gnyer ral pa gcig /gha skyen skul byed ser tshabazang mchog chen po/ /muṅga zhags pa gshin rje mthar byed sogs/ /de rnams bcu po mnyam du lha mo bsten7/ /21—877

'khor lo'i gtso dang gtsug tor snroganod mdzes dang / /de bzhin mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lnga/ /sma ra med cing de rnams cod pan ldan/ /yan lag rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od sngon gyen du 'byung / /khro dang bcas par bzhad pa'i zhal gsum ni/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs shing spyan rnams dmar/ /shin tu mig zlum mi g.yo ba la sogs / /yangs lta brda bstan chos kun 'jigs med pa'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /dbyig kyesngon dang ni de bzhin rta mgrin dang / /stobs po che dang bgegs mthar byed bcas pa'i/ /drug po mig ser gzhan yang shin tu drag /drag por blta bas sdang ba thams cad 'dul / /gsus pa 'phyang zhing thung la mig kyang zlum/ /shin tu lce bskyod khro gnyer 'jigs la drag /smin ma g.yo zhing spyan bgrad zhal mche gcigs ④—/ /khros pas rnam 'jigs ha ha zhes bzhad pa/ /smin ma sma ra ser zhing skra ser skya/ /cod pan med cing rus pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /rked pa'i phyogs su stag gi pags pa mnabs/ /skad cig gis ni 'gro ba za mthur ldan / /drag po 'di rnams mgon bo'i ⑪cod pan ni/ /rigs ldan dang ni mtha' yas mdog gnag gyur/ /'jog po zhes klu gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /de bzhin du ni rna — cha dag tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin pad+ma zhes tsogaser btso ma'i phya mdog /'di rnams kyis mdzes mgul pa'i do shal gyur/ /stobs rgyu pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dra dkar ba/ /thugs rje ldan pa rnams kyi mchod phyir thogs/ /pad+ma dmar ba 9—'dra ba'i nor rgyas bu/ / 'og pag ⑫dag gi rgyu ru bcing byas te / /dung dang pad+ma dmar dang dkar ba gnyis/ /pad 'dra pad+ma'i rkang 21—878

gdub gnyis su byas/ /g.yas phyogs su ni 'khor lo myur bar 'khor/ /khro bo'i tshogs de rnams ni mi 'gul lta/ /rtsibs rnon po yis yongs bcad dum bu yi/ /nyon mongs sa phyogs bdud rnams slar mi skye/ /dkon mchog gsum la 'di ru sun 'byin 'gyur/ /de la gtso bo gnod mdzes kyi tūsngags kyis/ /da ni rnam par bzlog nas phyir phyogs su/ /khro bo'i tshogs de rnams ni bskyod par byas/ /oṃ āḥ.uspyo ṣa badz+ra tsakra brti sarba lo ka ki lo kot+ta ra yan+t+ra—/ man+t+ra mū thul pra yo gā dī nī ma ma kṛ —ti ye na ke na tsita kṛṭ+wān+ta 4/ni/bhin+da t+tan+da/ tshin+da stson+da/5 mu ru mu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ shaṃ pa ya kai pa ya/ bidh+wad+ma ya bidh+wabe+e ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ bi tsūr+ṇa ya bi tsūr+ṇa kyeya/ uṭī ṣa be+e dza ya tsakra brti/ rgyu 7hūṃ/ de nas ji skad bshad pa'i bsgom ④pa yis/ /dgongs ka lan gsum sngags 'di bzlas par bya/ /sdang bar sems par byed pa de yi ni/ /de nyid kyis grub tsu 'gyur te the tshom med/ /gshin rje mthar byed la sogs rang sprul pa/ /phyogs bcur gnas pa'i drag po spro bar bya/ /de rnams kyis kyang sna tshogs yongs khyab pas/ /bgegs dbang rnams kyi mgul nas thag pas bcings oṃ sum̐ bha'i sngags ni zhal bzhi pas/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu brjod nas bsrung bar bya /yongs su bsrungs nas khro bo'i tshogs sprul pas/ /shin tu khro dang bcas pa'i sdang mig gis/ /gtso bo'i rdo rje tho ba dbyug sogs kyis/ /rang gi lus kun rab tu brdung bar gyur bhe/ /mdun du zhags pas drangs shing bsdams nas ni / /sna tshogs sa la gdong yang sbyar bar byas/ /de nas 'od 'bar rdo rje phur bu yis/ /de steng rang gzugs ji lta bzhin du sprul/ /bsdus nas 21—879

'khor lo'i gtso bo'i bka' thob nas/ /khro dang bcas pa'i gnod mdzes lus kyis ni/ /lag pa g.yon pa kun du 'od ldan pas/ /snying rje med par khu tshur gyis bsdams 1/te/ /bgegs tshogs de rnams mgon pos bsdus nas ni/ /phur bu gdab/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ke 1na dang / oṃ badz+ra la sogs bzlas pa'i tho ba yig/ /nam mkha' bsdams shing khro drag lta stangs kyis / /lag pa g.yas pas shin tu brdung bar bya/ /yongs su bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs so // //④de nyid gsum gyi sa bon dkar dmar gnag /mgo dang zhabs su ho ser gnyis dkyil bcug /nam mkha'i phyogs nas nor bu bzhin lhung ste/ /kha yi nang nas nang du rab tu zhugs/ /de nas snying rje ldan pas gzugs brtag pa / /dngos po smig rgyu dbang bo'i gzhu rang bzhin/ /bsgoms nas bdag med rang bzhin bsams nas ni/ /shu n+ya la sogs sngags rnams brjod par bya/ /ma rig pa'o/ /skad cig de la kha yi nang du zhugs/ /'khor lo 'byung bas zla ba'i gzugs su gyur/ /de dbus hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar/ /zla hūṃ rdo rje las byung kun du bzang / /zhal gsum de rnams kyi ni nyis 'a 'gyur phyag /zhal ni gangs ri'i mdog 'dra gnag dang dmar/ /rdo rje ral g.yas nor bu pad+ma g.yon/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rang gi rig ma 'khyud/ /g.yas pas g.yas min brla yi rgyab mnan cing / /g.yon pas g.yas pa yongs su mnan pa yis/ /sna tshogs pad+ma la ni skyil krung bcings/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bcas 'od stong /trephreng ba 'phro/ /kun du bzang las byung ba'i chos kyi dbyings/ /rdo rje gsum stong dkar po'i gru gsum ste/ /hūṃ ser gyis sprul zab mo dbus su ni/ /paṃ 21—880

ser de las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad/ /pad steng khaṃ ljang de las byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs bcur rigs 'od 'gyed/ /rdo rje'i steng byung zla ba la gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ byung 1'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /rten 'byel las ni kun du byung sdeb yi/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyis mtshan pa'i—/ /rigs bcas rnam par snang mdzad blta bar bya/ /kun du bzang po'i rang gzugs ji lta bzhin/ /'di yi 'od zer mkha' dbyings rnam spros pas//mnar med me chen la sogs rnam par zhi/ /sems can rnams kyi 'dod pa phun tshogs grub/ /de bsdus bdag nyid zla ba sa bon la/ /spro bsdu yang byas las byung sangs rgyas sku/ /sna tshogs rigs kyi bye brag tha dad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sku las byung ba'i sna tshogs 'od/ /mthu yis de la dkyil 'khor dag tu gyur/ /zur bzhi pa la shin tu mdzes par byas/ /de la sgo rnams de bzhin rta babs khyams / /zla ba dra phyed rin chen mdzes rnams dang / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan dril bu dang / /ye shes dam pa bsod nams tshogs gnyis kyi/ /btso rka ma'i gser gyi rang bzhin bum pa bzang / /mdzes pa rnams kyis ngu nang dang phyi rol bzhag /rdo rje rdo rje phyed pa rtse lngas brgyan/ /sna tshogs g.yer ka dril bu'i sgra rnams dang / /me long dang bcas rnga yab rnams kyis brgyan/ /'khor lo rin chen chu skyes ral gris mtshan/ /ka ba brgyad can de ni rnam dgu ldan/ /sgo yi phyogs gnyis kyi ni ka ba ni/ /ri dwags gnyis dbus chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas 'khor lo byas shing zlum/ /de yi phyi rol kun du 'od tshogs 'khyil—/ /'du byed do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /nyi shur gcig gis ma tshang de rnams kyi/ /21—881

paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ /'gro ba ma lus nye bar 'khrul pas na//rnam par dag pa'i pad+ma'i gdan rnams yin/ /re las byung ba'i nyi ma bdun du gyur / /oṃ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i zla bcu gnyis/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges par bsreg ①pa'i phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i nyi ma bdun du gyur/ /bsod nams kun gyi myu gu bskyed pa'i phyir/ /zla ba'i gdan rnams dag ni byung ba yin/ /dbus su zla ba dbang po'i phyogs su'ang zla/ /yongs su lhag pa'i phyogs su'ang nyi ma gsum/ /zur bzhi mtshams rnams ④su yang zla ba'o/ /rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba nye bar mdzes/ /phyi rol zur bzhi dang ni mtshams rnams dang / /shar kyi sgo yi g.yon dang g.yas gnyis su/ /so so so so yi ni zla ba'i gzugs—/ /sgo rnams de nyid du ni nyi ma bzhi/ /de bzhin dbus su zla ba'i steng du ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ni rnam par bsgom/ /g.yon pa ke zla 'dir yi ge bcu drug sogs/ /g.yas pa'i zla gyur ka sogs ha mthar thug /zla bcas de la wa ya la gsum dang / /a ka pa o de la rab tu sbyar/ /de dag rnams ni nyis 'gyur rnams su bya/ /gang 'gyur rgya de gnyis ā li kā li zla/ /lugs su byung dang lugs las bzlog par bshad/ /dbyangs yig rnam dkar phreng ni gnyis su gyur/ /pha rol gsal byed rnams ni 'di ru dmar/ /de gnyis dbus su re ni rnam par bsam/ /zhu bas gnyi ga gcig gyur 'od kyi tshogs / /'od tshogs hūṃ byung hūṃ las rdo rje dmar/ /de yi dbus su zla gyur sa bon steng / /zla hūṃ rdo rje las byung zla dbus su/ /ye shes rang bzhin las byung rdzogs par gyur/ /sku la sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag spras/ /me long ye shes la sogs nang du ni/ /21—882

sngags rnams lnga po 'di dag legs par sbyar/ /oṃ sogs tsi ta pra ti bya sgo ka /de srid mtha' mar de bzhin legs par brjod/ /kun gzhi rnam par shes pa gzhan gyur pa/ /zla gnyis 'dus gyur pa yi rnam snang mdzad/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin de gcig go/ /nyon mongs yid kyi rnam shes gzhan gyur pa/ /'od tshogs gang yin de yang rin chen 'byung / /de ni ye shes gnyis pa mnyam nyid gyur/ /rnam par rtog pa'i shes pa gzhan gyur pa/ /hūṃ byung rdo rje 'dzin pa 'od dpag med/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'di gsum pa/ /'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa gzhan gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i dbus kyi sa bon don yod grub/ /bya ba nan tan grub 'di bzhi pa yin/ /rang gi rnam par shes pa gzhan gyur pa//ye shes rnam bzhi rang bzhin gang yin gcig /de ni ye shes lnga par 'di ru bshad—/ /spro dang bsdu ba thams cad las byung ba'i/ /rnam dag gnyis med chos dbyings rdo rje sems/ /zhal gsum dbus dang yan lag thams cad dkar//g.yas dang g.yon pa'i ①/zhal gnyis sngo dang dmar/ / rdor la k+ṣegayas na rin chen pad+ma g.yon/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rig ma 'khyud pa'o/ /nyes pa thams cad 'bigs pas rdo rje ste/ /las dang ma rig kun gcod phyir ral gri/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi ni bsam pa rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ni rin chen no/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang 'dam kun gyisarnyi/ /ma gos par gyur phyir ni pad+ma'o/ /'di ni rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /srid gsum 'jig rten de ni nang gnas shing / /dngos po thams cad ro gcig chos kyi dbyings—/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yum/ /mtshan ni rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /'dod chags la sogs kyis gdungs chus khengs 21—883

pa'i / /'gro ba chu bo bzhi yis kun du bdas/ /nga rgyal la sogs dba' rlabs pha rol ngogs/ /thag ring klong du las kyi rlung gis shin tu bdas/ /byams pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /sems can 'khor bas gdungs pa mthong nas ni / /snying rje'i ting 'dzin rgya chen nyubaskyed par bya/ /thabs dang rig pa dgyes pa'i sgra 3rnams kyis/ /mkha' la sangs rgyas sems can dgyes pa bskyed/ /'od zer dra spros gedrangs pa'i mgon po rnams/ /kha yi dra bas nang du gzhug par bya/ /zhu gyur rdo rje lam byung gsang byung 'gyur/ /phyi na gnas pa'i lha mo rnam pa dgu/ /rim bzhin spos dang bdug pa mar me dang / /dri dang de bzhin me long la sogs lnga/ /mchod pa bya phyir lag na thogs par blta/ /lha mo rnams dang rang nyid rdo rje sems/ /dang po spyan la sogs pa spro bar bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa lha mo kun kyang 'byung / /be+er bcug thams cad rdo rje lam phyung nas/ /pad+ma'i gisgo ru nges par 'bab 'gyur te/ /gsang ba'i lte ba'i zla dbus gzhug par bya/ /'od zer de byung bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /bskyed nas srid pa gsum na gnas pa yi/ /sems can gang yin thams cad gzhug par bya/ /snying rje phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /rdo rjes bcom nas pad+ma legs phye ba'i/ /de yi 'od kyis sangs rgyas spyan drangs nas/ /khar gzhug rdo rje lam ni byung gyur pa/ /rgyal ba la sogs zla ba zhus dbang bskur/ /mig la sogs pa drug dang gzugs rdo rje/ /spyan la sogs dang bde bar gshegs pa lnga / /de bzhin gzhan yang khro bo bzhi rnams dang / /de dag rnams ni rang gi gzugs su gyur/ /dga' ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten khams gnas gyur/ /phyi rol sems can gzhan dag dga' med pa/ /21—884

k+ṣiṃ rmyel sogs pa'i sa bon gyis spro ste/ /de rnams thams cad byang chub la gzhol byas—/ /gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /sems can don du smon lam byas gyur pa/ /gang yin de ni bdag gis yongs su bskyang —/ /'gro ba mya ngan 'das par 'dul don phyir/ /stong pa nyid du rab bzhugs byebazhed par gyur—/ /rnam par shes pa'o/ /btang ④snyoms yongs su snyerdzogs pa'o/ /oṃ dang s+dzahūṃ dkar zhing dmar dang gnag /'od ser ho gnyis kyi ni dbus gnas pa/ /kha yi nang bzhugs pad+ma'i dbus gnas te/ /mgon po rig ma gnyi ga zhu bar byas/ /'das dang ma byon pa dang da ltar gyi/ /sems can dag tu gyur pa gang cung zad/ /de rnams rgyu gang gis ni yongs grol ba6 / /mgon po bzhugs pa stong nyid rab zhugs gyur/ /gang rnams thog ma med pa'i dus dbus bsgom/ /thog med dus mtha' nas —ske mi g.yo ba'i/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi gzugs kyi lha mo rnams/ /rdo rje thugs khyod la sogs pa bzhi yis/ /rang gi glu rnams kyis ④ni yang dag bskul/ /rdo rje rdzogs la stong nyid yang dag spangs / /saṃ bsam snga ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du gyur/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i gdan dbus su/ /zla ba bcu gnyis dang ni nyi ma bdun/ /de dbus pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dbus su/ /oṃ las byung ba'i ral gri rnam par bsam//ral gri'i kyesteng du yang ni zla oṃ ste/ /ral gri zla oṃ las byung 'jam rdo rje/ /ming dang gzugs so/ / ral gri ⑨zhal dang rang sku bye gur kum mdog /g.yas pa sngo zhing g.yas pa min pa'ang skyedakar/ /ral gri mda' dang ut+pal gzhu bsnams ⑩shing / /de yi phyag gnyis shes rab kun du 'khyud/ /shes rab rnam dag ngo bo ral gri ste/ /chos rnams 'bigs par byed pa nyid kyis ni/ /21—885

rnam par dag pa'i thabs kyi ngo bo mda'/ /sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas na/ /ut+pal sngon po nyes kun gnyen po dang / /yon tan thams cad 'dzin par byed pa'i gzhu/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mchog rnams kyis brgyan cing / /yid du 'ong ba'i rin chen mchog gis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lngar 1 byas bdag nyid lus las lcespro/ /ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo dpal gyis mdzes/ /rang gri kyes bon dkyil 'khor dbus su oṃ ④ / /yang na gzhan ci 'dod pa'i cho gas mgon/ /de nyid kyi 3ni gnas su gyur pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor dbang po de yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'i sems nyid med/ /oṃ dharma 4jo tu la sogs sngags brjod cing tsu/ /brjod pa tsam gyis rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ /de 'dir bsnyen pa'i yan lag rdzogs byas pa'i/ /mig gnyis nang dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /yan lag dam pa brang dang zla gnas drug / k+ṣiṃ dz+rī byede bzhin khaṃ shaṃ de nas yang / /sko saṃ yi ge drug nyid rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri dang ni rdo rje rim bzhin du/ /phyag mtshan de rnams yang dag byung ba dang / /mtshan ma de rnams dbus su zla sa bon/ /phyag mtshan zla ba sa bon bcas byung ba'i/ /yan lag sa bon dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan rigs she/ /drug po brla gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis/ /zla bcas sna tshogs pad+ma kun du gnas/ /sa dbang rdo rje'i dbang po lag na rin//'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib sel kun du bzang / /dkar dang sngo dang de bzhin ser dang dmar/ /ljang dang skya dang gzhan yang de la sogs/ /sa yi dbang phyug gzugs kyi rdo rjes r+sha'akhyud/ /rdo rje dbang po yang ni sgra rdo rjes/ /nam mkha'i snying po kyedri yi rdo rjes 'khyud/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kyang ⑫ni ro yis 21—886

te / /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba reg pas 'khyud/ /chos kyis 'khyud pa yang ni kun du bzang / /de rnams bcu gnyis phyi nang dbye ba las/ /skye mched de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /gzugs rdor la sogs lha mo de dag rnams/ /gang yin phun tshogs skye mched dkyil 'khor gnas/ /de dag rnams la 'khyud gyur hūṃde bzhin du/ /bzlog pas gnas tshe thams cad de bzhin gyur2/ /de bzhin rtag tu bsgom pa bsgom bdag nyid/ /skad cig la ni mngon shes drug thob 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /gyur te nye ba yi ni sgrub pa rdzogs/ /reg pa'o/ /rdo rje gsum rdzogs nges par gnas don du/3/ /zla gsum snying ga sgog ma mgo bor yang / /brang dang sgog ma'i bar du bzhi pa dgod/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ gi — rdo rje las byung thugs rdo rje/ /a ni khyapad+ma las byung khyad 'phags ngag /oṃ gyi 'khor lo yis ni sku rdo rje/ /rma gyi kyeral gri las byung 'jam rdo rje/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa sprul pa yi/ /sku gsum rnam par grol ba'i bdag nyid de / /des dbyings ye shes rang bzhin bzhi pa'o3/ /sngon po dmar po dang ni dkar dang ser/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya che/ /ngag gi snyerdo rje'i sku 'khyud chos phyag rgya/ /dam pa'i sku yi rdo rje las phyag rgya/ /'jam dbyangs nyid 'khyud dam tshig phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams bzhi po zla ba'i 'od kyis brgyan / /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis kyang shin tu gnas/ /phyag rgya rnams kyi so so'i dbus su ni/ /'di ltar bsgom par bya zhes la la 'chad/ /de rnams kyi ni dbus su 'di lta yang / /re baṃ yi lo la sogs yi ge dgod par bya/ /'di rnams bzhi po rdzogs par gyur pa dang / /me chu rlung dang dbang gi dkyil 'khor 21—887

rnams / /dmar po gru gsum dkar zhing zlum pa dang / /gzhu 'od sngon po ser po gru bzhi pa'o/ /mdung dang bum pa ba dan rdo rje yis/ /go rims 1ji bzhin de rnams mtshan par 'dod/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su rang sa bon/ /dmar ba phyag mtshan zla ༄ 7gnas nyis 'gyur bya/ /mdog dang phyag mtshan rnams dang gdan la sogs/ /thugs rdo rje dang 'dra bar de rdzogs bya/ /rig ma spangs shing phyag gnyis zhal gcig ste/ /cod pan mtshon cha rgyan med de rnams ni / /sngar gsungs dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su ni/ /rnam par bsgom par bya zhes gzhan rnams 'chad/ /sems kyi 'od zer tshogs las rang byung ba'i//shes rab yan lag gis 'khyud gsal ba'i thugs/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhing rnams yang dag mchod ga/ /rang gi ④ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang zhes thugs brjod de/ /chos kyi gsung lam zhes bshad gsung brjod de/ /de bzhin dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang sku ste/ /de ltar sngags brjod 'di ni sgrub yan lag /sngags spangs brjod de sems kyis dbang bskur te/ /dpal ldan ye shes sems dpa' rtag tu bskul/ /gang phyir 'di ni rdo rje 'dzin rgyud gsungs/ /shes rab rno can de rnams kyis rab sgrub/ /tshor ba'o/ /bdag gis bdag snying ye shes 'od tshogs kyis/ /mkha' bzhugs rgyal ba ma lus yang dag bskul/ /de yi lus nang byung ba'i 'od zer las—/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje rang byung gzhan yang ni/ /dpal ldan mā ma khri dang gos dkar can/ /sgrol ma zhes bya lha mo de rnams ni/ /rnga yi sgra ldan rnams kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /byug pa la sogs me tog phreng thogs shing / /gser gyi bum pa ye shes chus gang ba/ /bkra shis bum pa lag thogs klu byernams 21—888

kyis / /rang gtso cod pan thogs shing mkha' ༄1dkyil gnas/ /mchog tu dbang bskur bar ni dbab par bya/ /bab 'gyur de nyid las ni byung ba yi/ /mi bskyod rdo rje cod pan dag tu gnas/ /mthong na shin tu sems ni rnam dag par—/ /gyur pa de nyid sgrub pa chen po'o/ /srid pa'o/ /rig ma mtshan mchog yon tan kun ldan pa/ /rang gi sa bon las byung kun du rtog /dkyil 'khor mngon sum du ni rab tu gzhagakye /de la bsten pa la sogs des byas bdag /sa snying la sogs rnams kyis gang bar blta/ /sku la sogs pa'i yi ge gsum gyi lus/ /de 'dir chos la sbyar bar gyur pa yis /glo bur las byung lus ni kun du dgang / /mgo snying lte ba rked pa brla gnyis su//oṃ hūṃ swā s+dzahā zhes go rims ④bzhin/ /de rnams mdog ni bye brag shes nas ni/ /rnam dgod rigs lnga ru ni rab tu bya/ /a las byung ba'i gsang ba'i lte bar ni/ /dh+ri las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /nor bu oṃ dang rang gi rdo rje hūṃ/ /sbubs gnyis su ni yi ge phaṭa bsgom bya/ /de 'og oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes/ /a nu rā ga na 'khyud gnyis su bya/ /len pa'o/ /de nas sngar bshad dbang bskur shes byas nas/ /rig dang lhan cig 'di ru dga' bar bya/ /srid pa'o/ /dang por 5bsnyen pa'i yan lag de nas nyer sgrub pa/ /bsgrub 6pa'i yan lag chen po la sogs kyang / /rtul po la sogs sbyor byas so sor ni/ /'gyur te bzhi ru yang ni bshad par grags/ /rtul sogs rgyu mthun rnam smin skyes bu byed//dbang gi 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi ru bzhag /bsnyen pa'i yan lag nas brtsams bya ba nas/ /thabs las byung ba'i bya ba rnam pa bzhi/ /shes rab kyis 'gyur de bzhin cho ga rnams/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag la sogs dbang bsgur 7mtha'/ /21—889

rgyu mthun la sogs bcas pa dbus kyi ming / /yan lag bzhir 'gyur dang po'i sbyor ba'o/ /snying ga'i zla dbus gnas pa'i sngags 'od kyihūṃ7/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku la ma lus gzhug /bde ba chen po las byung byang chub sems/ /hūṃ rdor las byung dkyil 'khor dkyil dbang dgod/ /skye ba'o/ /dwo ṣa ra tī ra 2bcas pa'i thugs rdo rje/ /in+d+ra byā la bcas byas lus 'chang zhing / /zhe sdang /ngo bo sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /bzhugs pa'i badz+ra dh+rika ④ni zla dbus su/ /rga shi'o / /zlo 5'khor las ni dzi na dzika gtso bo/ /rnam par snang mdzad gti mug 'dra rang bzhin/ /zla ba bye ba yi ni 'od gsal ba/ /shar phyogs zla dbus mo ha ra tīr 6bcas/ / s+t+waṃ gi 2rin chen las byung gser babo'i 1'od/ /rin dbang mgon po badz+ra ra t+t+waṃr ⑪bcas/ /nga rgyal gtso bo rat+na dh+rika ces pa/ /'di gdan nyi ma'i steng bzhugs lho phyogs su/ /dz+rī me gi pad+ma las byung mtshal mdog 'od/ /'dod chags la bzhugs mgon po 'od dpag med/ /rā ga ra ṣ+ṭṛs 11dam 'khyud ā ro t+pakaskya /nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs 'gyur nub phyogs su/ /khaṃ gi ral gri las byung mdog mchog ljang / /phrag dog rang bzhin de yang don yod grub/ /nu ma gnyis bsten badz+ra ra tīr 15bcas/ /pradz+nyā rjaka ces byang phyogs nyi dbus su/ /ye shes lnga phung rnam par dag pa'o/ /lam gyi 'khor lo las byung mtshams su ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad mdog 'dra zla dkyil nas/ /sgeg pa'i cha byad rgyal la rab tu chags/ /mo ha ra ti gang yin de nyid spyan/ /saṃ gyi ⑫ut+pal dmar mo'i suphyag mtshan byung / /mi bskyod pa 'dra gshin rje'i phyogs zla dbus/ /rtag tu dang po'i sangs rgyas thabs cig spyosbyor/ /dre ṣa ra ti mā ma shī gzhan min/ /paṃ gyi dze+epad+ma las byung zla dbus su/ /snang ba mtha' 21—890

yas mdog 'dra rlung gi phyogs/ /pad+ma'i mgon po yis ni kun du 'khyud/ /gos dkar gang yin rā ga ra tī'ang de/ /t+t+waṃ hūṃgi ut+pal gser las byung gyur pa//rin dbang 'od 'dra badz+ra ra tre+e zu sgrol/ /dbang ldan phyogs su zla ba la gnas shing / /don yod rdo rje'i yan lag gis 'khyud byas/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /phyi rol byung nas me yi phyogs su ni/ /skor phyogs de nyid kyi ni nang du'ang / /zla ba drug dbus rang gi phyag mtshan rgyu/ /'od ldan yi ge drug po mthong nas ni/ /mtshams de rnams su dzaḥ3hūṃ baṃ hoḥ4dang / /khaṃ re shar gyi sgo thugyur phyogs gnyis su/ /me long pi wang 4dkar po dri dung chos//ro yi snod dang ⑦sna tshogs gos mkha' dbyings/ /sa bon bsam 8pa'i mtshan ma de mthong nas/ /gzugs rdo rje sogs lha mo de rnams drug /de rnams sa bon la sogs mdog 'dra zhing / /lus la rtag tu de nyid gsum bsam bya/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam par dag pa'o/ /re hūṃ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa / /hūṃ gi sa bon mtshan byung khro bo'i gzugs/ /ji skad bshad pa'i khro bo'i tshogs nang gnas/ /bsgom bya de rnams rtag tu g.yas brkyang bzlog /mya ngan 'das srid rnam dag g.yas brkyang ba'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed dbang po zhes bya'i sgor/ /shes rab mthar byed nyi ma la skyes phyogs/ /pad+ma mthar byed klu yi gtso bo'i phyogs/ /bgegs mthar byed pa rnam thos phyogs na gnas//dad pa la sogs pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed de yi be tā līlku/ /shes rab mthar byed gzhan kyis mi thub ma/ /pad+ma mthar byed lhan cig khro gnyer can/ /bgegs mthar byed pa ral pa gcig mar dmigs—/ /ma lus 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma la/ /nyi zla'i dbus su ji lta ba 2 1—891

bzhin bzhugs/ /zhi ba'i gzugs can gang yin 'dir lha rnams/ /de rnams thams cad rdo rje'i byal 1krung gyur/ /ting 'dzin chen po thob pas shin tu zhi/ /bdud rnams bzhi las mchog tu rgyal gyur pas/ /rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje skyil krung ngo / /sangs rgyas sogs gzhan lha mo rnams bcas pa /dgyes pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnam par sbyar/ /dbus na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo yi/ /zhal 'di rnams kyi zhal ni nges par ltaphye/ /rigs rnams dang po'i rigs ni rdo rje'i rigs/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rin chen rigs gsum pa/ /de nas pad+ma'i rigs ni bzhi pa ste/ /sna tshogs rigs ni la lar las kyi rigs/ /sngon po la sogs gang yin mdog lnga yang / /de mdog tha dad pas ni rigs rnams 5lnga/ /sems can bsam pa tha dad mdog tha dad/ /rigs las rang byung sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /de rnams yan lag mchog rnams gsum gyis brgyan/ /sku gsung thugs ni rnam dag zhal gsum pa'o/ /sngon po dkar po gnyis kyi 4g.yon pa dmar/ /g.yas pa gnyis mdog rnam par zlog pa'o/ /ser po dang ni dmar po ljang gu'i sku/ /g.yas min dang ni g.yas pa dkar dang sngo/ /rigs kyi lha mo 'di dag rnams kyi ni/ /zhal gyi mdog rnams kyang ni so sor gyur/ /de rnams phyag drug dang ni yang dag ldan/ /gtso bo'i phyag gnyis kyis ni mtshon cha spangs/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje khu tshur ni / /so so so sor nges bcings de 'og tu/ /mthe'u chung rtse mo lcags kyu'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lag pa gnyis kyi thumakhrig ma gnyis ni sbyar/ /gnas ldan gang yin la ni phyi rol gyis/ /de yi phang dbus 'dug 'gyur des mgul phyogs//g.yon pa'i nang du lag gnyis phyi rol gyur/ /gcig la gcig 'khyud phyag rgya 21—892

bcing bar bya/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam dag phyag drug po/ /bste ne+e bak+to ba ri tsusbra ma na/ /darnye shwa na haṃ pa ri ghi sha ma na/ /thabs dang rig pa'i yan lag mi phyed par/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rgyal po'i rnam par bsgom/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam dag 'khyud pa'o/ /gang yang phyag mtshan mchog las byung gang yin—/ /mtshan ma mchog de lag pa g.yas su ste/ /phyag gsum thams cad la ni ral gri'o/ /ral gri las byung 'khor lo 'dzin 'gyur te/ /rin chen rigs kyi g.yon pa pad+mar gyur/ /de bzhin thupad+ma rigs kyi rin chen te/ /'di gnyis kyi ni gsum dar pya 'khor lor gyur/ /gzhan rnams kun gyi lag pa nor bu pad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dag pa dang/ /shes rab pha rol rnam dag phyag mtshan no/ /rgyal ba lnga po rnams kyi ral pa'i tshogs/ /'dir ni de rnams bye brag gcig yod 'gyur/ /zhi ba rnams ni rin 'bar cod pan thogs—/ /khro bo rnams ni sbrul gyis sku brgyan cing / /dpung pa lag ngar rked pa rkang pa dag /mgrin pa dang ni rna ba mgor thogs pa/ /'od ldan nor bus spras pa gser gyis bcings/ /ji lta ji ltar yan lag rgyan gyis brgyan/ /thabs kyis sdegyur pa gang yin shes rab kyi/ /phyag dang mdog dang mtshon cha gos 'byung ba/ /gnas dang gnas pa nyid kyis 3gang dang gang / /de rnams kyang ni sar gyur sa sneyir gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni gsang 'gyur rnam par bsamaske/ /byung nas de yang go rims dz+waji lta bzhin/ /yid gsum badz+ra dh+rika sogs sngags rnams kyis/ /dam tshig la sogs pa dang thabs cig bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje snying gar thugs rdo rje/ /rab zhugs nam mkha' dang mnyam ngo bo nyid / /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs gzhan rnams kyang / /gsang ba'i 21—893

nang bshad gang yin phyogs rnams su'o/ /de dbus sngags kyi 'od zer rnams 1byung nas/ /gshin rje mthar byed ltar gyur nam mkhar gnas/ /rdo rje lcags kyus 'khor lo drangs nas ni/ /de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dag tu bya/ /rdzogs nas yon khyab 2mchog bkang pad+ma'i snod/ /lag pa gnyis kyis kun du bzung nas kyang / /de nas lag pa g.yon pas ba dan gzung kye/ /lag pa g.yas pa yi ni tsan+dan mdzes/ /me tog chu sogs kyis mdzes bdud rtsi lnga/ /rang gi snying sogs bzlas 5pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gshin rje mthar byed la sogs thams cad kyang / /dzaḥ3zhes lhag par smra zhing srung bar byed/ /de bzhin khro gzhan rang gi las kyi mtha'/ /dzaḥ/4hūṃ baṃ hoḥpobacas pa'i sgra sgrogs shing / /gzhan gyis mi thub pad+ma bgegs mthar byed/ /rab bzhugs bcings pa dang ni dgyes par byed/ /zhes pa'i bar gyur 'di ltar lhag bsnyen pa/ /lhag pa'i rgyu mthun 'bras bu dang lhan cig /de nas thams cad kun du dgyes pa dang / /mig la sogs pa'i yan lag byin gyis brlab/ /sku sogs tshig gsum gyis ni byin brlabs te/ /dbang bskur byas pa'i dus kyi tha mar 1 gnas/ /de rnams rim gyis gnas pa'i bar du ni/ /lhag pa'i 'bras bu gsum bcas yan lag go/ /rang gi sems las kun 'byung 'od chen 'phros—/ /nam mkha'i rgyal dang rig ma kun nas drangs/ /nam mkha' khyab par gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ /rang gi bdag po bcings nas cod pan bcings—/ /gshin rje mthar byed pad mthar rdo rje gzhan/ /khro bo bgegs dgra — rterang gi dkyil 'khor gnas/ /nga rgyal bzhi po sems bdag 'jam dbyangs bcas/ /kun du bzang dang phyag na rdo rje dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje 21—894

sems dpa' chos dbyings dang / /dpal ldan dwo ṣa rar 1bcas sgra rdo rje/ /'di rnams cod pan rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i steng du rdo rje sems/ /sa snying sku dbang dang ni gzugs rdo rje/ /gshin rje mthar byed mo ha ra t+t+waṃ 3bhernams / /'di rnams kyi ni spyi bor rnam snang bzhugs/ /mkha' snying dri yi steng du rin chen tog /ngag rdor 'jig rten dbang phyug dri dang ro/ /pad mthar phyin rnams cod pan 'od dpag med/ /reg rdor sgrib sel badz+ra ra tī ༄/rnams—/ /spyi bor yang ni don yod grub pa bzhugs/ /rang gi sa bon pad+ma'i nang gnas pa'i/ /'od kyis kyang ni phyag rgya lnga drangs nas/ /kha yi nang zhugs gsang ba'i dbus gnas te/ /zhu nas de las gzugs la sogs par gyur/ /sku rdor la sogs mtshan ma de lha mo/ /me long sogs gang yin de las byung spros/ /gzhan yang phyi rol me tog bdug ④spos sogs/ /de rnams nam mkha' la ni gdugs bzhin gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dang / pū dza la sogs sgra yi sngags brjod cing / /mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs tshigs bcad lnga/ /brjod nas de nas mdun du rnam bsam pa/ /yam̐ las byung ba'i 'od sngon gzhur byas nyid/ /rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /de nas ram̐ byung shin tu mdog dmar ba'i/ /gru gsum gyen gnas kyime yi tshogs kyis mnan/ /de nas me yi steng du 'od dmar i// /de las byung ba'i pad+ma'i snod mchog bsam/ /rnam pa bco lnga'i klurdzas kyis yongs gang ba'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sa bon lnga rnams kyis/ /oṃ hūṃ zla ba gnyis ni mkha' dkyil gnas/ /zhugs 8/nas de yi nang du lhung bar gyur—/ /skol bas oṃ ni tshur gyur kun du blta/ /hūṃ gi sa bon las byung rdo rje nang / /rdo rjes dkrugs par rmyernam par zhu gyur pa/ /yi ge t+t+waṃ bzlas ye shes 21—895

bdud rtsir gyur/ /de las gzhan pa yi ni snod rnams kun/ /thams cad rang gi lag na thogs par spro/ /lce yi rtse mor hūṃ byung rdo rje dkar/ /snying la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rgyal/ /thams cad kun du tshim par bsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa'i mchog 'gyur ting 'dzin to/ /gang yang 'jam dbyangs rdo rje thugs ka yi/ /sems dpa'i snying po las byung 'jam ral gri/ /oṃ las byung ba'i sems kyi me bsgoms te/ /rdo rje gsum sku dang yang mnyam tu༄por byung / /de rnams snying gnas 2rang mtshan sa bon las/ /byung nas ye shes 'od zer rab gsal ba'i/ /'od kyis —ma lus sna tshogs kun du gang / /ye shes bdud rtsi rgyun gyi 4rjes song nas/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad bsgral 3kanas kyang / /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi gzhan dang gzhan bsdus nas/ /'og tu gdong bltas 6nas ni de byung bas/ /skad cig gis ni 'jig rten gsum bcas rgyal/ /ma lus sna tshogs sangs rgyas nyid byas nas/ /'ongs nas spyi bo'i nang du rab tu zhugs / /lus kun tshim par kun du gyur nas ni/ /thang cig 1de la yang ba'i rang bzhin gyur/ /de nyid gsum mchod cho ga bzhin du bya/ /saṃ gyi shenang du rab zhugs rnam par blta/ /saṃ las byung gyur ral gri dbus su ni/ /zla gnas tsa na ka tsam thig ler gnas/ /de dbus dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor gyi dbang po/ /nyi shur gcig gis ma tshang de rnams spudag /gang dang gang gis skyo med de bsgoms te/ /mngon sum byas nas thig le'i sbyor ba'o/ /rang lha'i sa bon las byung 'od 'phros pas/ /phyi rol gyi ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams / /chos 'byung zhes bya'i sna yi rtse mor zhugasashārte/ /yang dag byang chub sems byung 'jam ral gyipo/ /yang na 'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje'am/ /nas kyi tshad 21—896

dam zla ba'i dbus su ni/ /de yi steng du saṃ byung mdog lnga pa'i/ /yungs kar tshad tsam rin chen zur brgyad pa/ /rin chen dbus su re byas ri1 'khor lo nyid//gang yin de gyur rnal 'byor shes mchog gis/ /rdo rje sogs mtshan de bzhin gshegs rnams kyi/ /de rnams nyin snedang mtshan ma spro bar bya/ /mtshan ma brtan por byas pas brtags —na ni/ /'od zer du ba'i 'od dang de bzhin gzhan—/ /me khyer 'od dang snang ba chen po ste/ /rim gyis mthar thug phra mo'i spyor ba'o/ /rngub pa dang ni gnas dang ring du gyur/ /sdud dang gang ba dang ni 'dzin pa rnams/ /'ong ba dang ni rjes dran sngon grub rnams/ /srog ma bsdams par gyur pa gang yin dge/ /oṃ dang dbugs de mnyam du nang du zhugs—/ / āḥyi ④ sngags dang thabs cig phyedabus na gnas/ /hūṃ gi mthar ni rang gi sgra dang ldan/ /bzlas pa rkan tre dang mchu sbyar spang bar bya/ /de nyid sa bon las 'dir sangs rgyas spro/ /'od zer tshogs de nam mkhar song nas kyang / /de nas byung ba'i lha mo de rnams kyis/ /dam tshig ces bya'i 'khor la mchod par byed/ /thams cad kun du 'khyud par gyur pa dang / /dga' ba dag 3gis sangs rgyas rnams 'khyud 'gyur/ /de nas rang byas snying ga'i sems rdo rje/ /skad cig de la thub dbang zhugs par blta/ /gal te bsgoms dang bzlas pas skyo gyur na/ /rang gi snying ga'i de nyid rnam bsgoms pas—/ /rig ma'i tshogs 'ongs nas ni glu yi sgras/ /de dang de yis 'khor lo mchog sad byas/ /mgo bo spags bye pa'i mtho gang tsam du ni/ /ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba dgod/ /bdud rtsi lnga rnams oṃ dang ldan pa ni/ /zhu bas skad cig de la rang lus bab/ /bsam bya gangs chu bsil 'dra bab gyur pas/ /21—897

ma lus skyo ba rnam par bsal bar bya/ /de nas thang cig de yis ngal sos ①nas//be+er yang de yi zhegasang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ /gong du bshad pa'i dbang bskur mchod pa dang / /bstod /pa la sogs smon lam mthar thug ④brjod/ /byas nas gang dag gang rigs rab 'byung ba'i/ /de ni de dang de yi snying gar gzhug /de nyid gsum tshig gis ni byin brlab ⑤bya/ /gnas nas thogs bhu med ye shes gnyis med tshul/ /de la gshegs gsol gleng gzhi ④de rnams ni/ /las rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i ting 'dzin no/ /de las langs nas ting 'dzin spyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid chen por rang lha'i rnam pa gzung / /snang ba tsam du yul de mthong nas ni/ /sgu sogs rerdo rje bdag nyid dngos rnams dag /rang gi sa bon las byung yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /'khor lo rang gi snying gar kyezhugs par bsam/ /ram̐ las byung ba'i me yang bsgom par bya/ /zan zar gyur pa'i tshe na 'di skad gsungs/ /sngar bshad rlung dang me dang dgong ce dbus su/ /rdo rje la sogs cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /sku sogs lha rnams kun du tshim par bya/ /nang gi bdag nyid kyis (nyeni sbyin sreg las/ /mthar thug par yang sems kyi bya ba ste/ /phung po la sogs bud shing kun dang ⑫ldan/ /ye shes me 'bar ba yis muphung po ni/ /bsregs pa gang yin de ni bla med bshad/ /ma lus 'dod pa yi ni cho ga nyid/ /de yis rang gi lha yi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /rang dang gzhan lus la yang kun du mchod/ /sangs rgyas rnams bsten dam tshig shin tu thob/ /rjes su mthun pa'i 'gro ba'i don byas shing / /de bzhin gshegs rnams kun du mchod par bsam/ /sems ni gcig tu mnyam par gzhag —gyur pas/ /lus la sogs pa'i las rnams rtag tu bya/ /gang yang 21—898

༄/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/cho༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa man+ta bha dra nā ma sā dha rgo2/ bod skad du/kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan//dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan cing / /shes rab yan lag 'dus pas 'bar zhing rnam mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhung lugs bshes gnyen ni/ /dam pa yis ni bskul phyir spro byas te/ /'go ba ma lus don ni phun tshogs pa'i/ /rgyur gyur cho ga bdag gis bshad par bya/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yi/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /de la sngags pa snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed pa dang / /21—905

gtong ba la sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /zab mo'i tshul dag la ni lhag par mos/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yis/ /rang gi dbang bskur phun sum tshogs ldan zhing / /cho ga bzhin du rjes gnang thob pa yi /blo dang ldan pas rang sngags mnyes par bya/ /la la dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing / /shing mchog mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'jam dbyangs zhes bya de ltar rab bsgrub bya/ /dang por nang par snying ga'i zla dbus su/ /dri med 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i saṃ/ /de nyid ces bya rnam bkod brtser ldan pas/ /sgo la sogs pa yang dag dag par bya / /tsan+dan bzang po la sogs kyis byugs shing / /dri zhim me tog gcal 1bkram mchog gi char pa/ /bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i stan la ni/ /gnas nas dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /dmigs te sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin rnams ni/ /dang por spro sogs blo ldan gyis bya zhing / /dge ba rnams ni 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ /sdig pa dag ni bshags pa la sogs bya/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog gepa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi5/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun 27—906

tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing / /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs nyupa/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /snying rjes 'jig rten 'di rgo ma lus pa/ /lta ba'i dra bas bcings la dmigs nas ni/ /yang dag byang chub sems ni mnyam med pa/ /sngags pas cho gas de ltar bsgom par bya/ /ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos po ni/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho2haṃ/ de 'og dh+ri gis rdo rjer byas pa'i sar/ /kun du bzang las byung bar bsam pa ni/ /ston ka'i zla ba lta bur rab dkar ba/ /mtha' yas phyogs gnas sna tshogs 'od dang ldan/ /gru ༄ gsum gyen du gnas pa'i nang gi ni/ /nam mkha' rang gi ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos 'byung zhes bya phyag rgya'i dbus gnas pa/ /pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje mdzes pa der/ /rgyu 4gyi 'khor lo las byung rig bcas pa'i/ /rnam snang mdzad yan lag las yang dag byung / /thub dbang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa'i/ /zer gyis phyogs tshogs ma lus kun du khyab/ /mi 21—907

mnyam pa dag med phyir zur bzhi mnyam/ /dran dang dbang po'i mchog gi sgo rnams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi po dag gi rta babs dang / /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni kun du bskor/ /kha khyer de la brten pa'i mchod pa ni/ /dam pa 'dzin pa gzungs kyi tshogs rnams yin/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam spras pa/ /gang phyir 'gro 1bsam kun rdzogs mdzad pa yi/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang / /dril bu sgra sgrogs phyogs sgo kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lag dgu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni skyob ldupa po / /me long dra ba dra phyed me tog gi/ /phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam pa med/ /ye shes me long dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag dri ni me tog phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin/ /rdo rje'i thig dang yang dag ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje theg chos 'khor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla med mtha' yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam par dag pa yin/ /mchod pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun yin/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab mar legs gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla mgon bcas lha yi gnas rnams dang / /rin chen ma lus pa yi 4rnam spras pa/ /gzhal yas khang pa der ni bsam par bya/ /bcu drug cha dang tshogs las byung ba yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag ni dbus nyid du/ /'od zer dpag tu med pa'i tshogs ldan pa/ /dbus ma'i gdan la cho ga bzhin du bsam/ /dpal mchog dang po'i snying po las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje bzang 'dir nor bu dmar 'dra la/ /dpag med thub pa'i 'od tshogs rnam 'phro ba/ /phyogs sgo mtha' yas khyad par rab 21—908

bsgrub pa/ /dang po'i snying po mchog bcas bsgoms nas ni/ /nga rgyal de ltar mtha' yas sprul pa yis/ /'gro ba mchog gi don rnams byas gyur cing / /thub mchog phra rab las bsgrubs mtshungs med pa/ /zla ba rgyas 'drar dkar ba'i mdangs ldan zhing / /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal ni sngo dang dmar/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams 'bar ba'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /rig ma dam par 'khyud par mdzad pa'o/ /lhag ma'i phyag gis rdo rje ral gri dang / /pad+ma rin chen bsnams pas zung gnyis mdzes/ /khams gsum khong ni rnam par brgyan pa yis//thub pa'i 'od tshogs du ma rnam par 'gyed/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum rnam dag pas/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid snying rje mchog /ma lus 'gro ba'i de nyid gcig pu nyid/ /rgyal ba skyed byed nyid kyi sku ru bsam/ /mchog tu rjes chags phun tshogs dpag med kyis/ /'dul ba'i 'jig rten thams cad dmigs nas ni/ /dga' ba'i sgyu ma'i sgra yis de rnams dang / /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus gzhug kyepar bya/ /de ni spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo dang / /gzugs sogs ma lus yul gyi rang bzhin du/ /phyung nas rig ma de dag thams cad ni/ /rang gi rig ma'i nang du chud par bya/ /de yi pad+ma'i lte ba'i nang du ni / /dkyil 'khor dri med zla zer las byung bar/ /bsams nas blo yis 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ /ma lus de ni rab tu gzhug par bya/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje dam pa'i dbus su ni/ /rnam snang la sogs rgyal ba'i tshogs bzhugs te༄ — / /zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa dang / /des ni de rnams de 'og dbang bskur bya/ /sa yi snying po phyag na rdo rje dang / /mkha' snying 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib sel bcas/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po zhes bya bas/ /de 21—909

dag mig 1la sogs pa grangs bzhin no/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang / /reg bya dang ni chos dbyings rdo rje dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams ni2/ /ngo bo nyid gyur spyan la sogs par grags/ /gzugs dang tshor ba de bzhin 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam par shes bshad pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs bde gshegs te/ /de rjes sa bon gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ / k+ṣiṃ dz+rī khaṃ shaṃ sko saṃ zhes bshad pa/ /'di dag mig la sogs pa rnams kyi ming 4/ /dzaḥ5hūṃ baṃ hoḥ bye khaṃ ram̐ zhes bshad pa/ /de dag gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa/ /lo rmā paṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃzhes bya bzhir bshad pa/ /de dag srun la sogs pa rnams kyi yin/ / rgyu sde dz+rī 3khaṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba 'di/ /rim pa ji bzhin rtag / pa la sogs pa'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ byehūṃ zhes bya ba'i sems nyid ni/ /'od ldan hoḥ )dang spel ba cho ga bzhin/ /pad+ma'i nang du zhugs pa mnyam med pa//shes rab chags pas zhu bar byas par skyebasam/ /de yi 'od kyi mthu yis gnyis ka yang / /zla ba zhu bar byas par mthong ba dang / /spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ni/ /glu yi sgra yis bskul bar byas par bsam sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab 1 tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni mugason par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen ⑩mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rab tu phan par gzigs//mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i 21—910

gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi don dang dgos pa mdzad la rab tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /dga' ba'i spyod pa kun du bzang po bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid thugs brtse ba/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de lta'i glu yi ngo ru byas pas na—/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur yang dag rig /snang ba'i 'od zer gyi ri1ni dkyil 'khor can/ /rang gi sngags kyis 2—lus su rang nyid gyur/ /de yi 'od zer ma lus pa rnams kyis/ /rang lha dang mtshungs sprul pa'i thub dbang pos/ /dpag tu med pa'i yid kyis bcug pa las/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes byar gyur/ /gur kum bzang po'i mdog ltar dmar ba la/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal ni sngo dang dkar/ /sna tshogs rgyan 1gyis rnam par brgyan pa yi//phyag gnyis shes rab dam par 'khyud pa dang / /mdangs ldan ral gri dang ni mda' nyid dang / /ut+pal sngon gzhu mtha' yas 'od ldan bsnams/ /ma lus rigs rnams 'phro bas rnam brgyan cing / /skyob pa nam mkha' ma lus dkyil 'khor yin/ /dngos rnams thams cad gzung dang 'dzin pa dang 5/ /bral bas dngos po med pa nyid du shes/ /rnam par byang la mngon par zhen pa ni/ /med pas byin gyis brlabs pa 'di nyid bya/ /oṃ dhan+d+ra dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko36haṃ/de 'og rang snying dze+es bon 'od rnams kyis/ /rang gi mig sogs sa snying la sogs pas/ /ji bzhin bkang nas dri med rang zla yis/ /rdo rje lte ba'i 21—911

dbus gnas yi ge hūṃ/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i de bzhin kha dang ni/ / mgo bor nya pad+ma 'khor lo la gnas pa'i/ /26/byedang oṃ ni gsung gi rdo rje dang / /sku yi rdo rje nyid du bsam par bya/ /de yi thugs ka'i zhu'od kyi tshogs rnams dang / /shes rab dam par gnas pa'i 'od rnams kyis/ /kun nas rgyal ba'i dbang po mchod nas ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la sogs byin gyis brlab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs 4nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs 5nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3ri haṃ/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs ④nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis 8mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs tso nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho7haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs ⑩nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pasamu/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs ⑫ nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ā kolharnguhaṃ/nam mkha' lta bu'i skengo bor rdo rje gsum/ /mtshan nyid dag dang bral bar dmigs nas ni/ /phyogs bcur kun du ⑩bzhugs pa'i thub pa'i tshogs/ /21—912

—snying po'i 'od zer rnams kyis yang dag bskul/ /thub pa'i mchog gi 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /rig pa'i tshogs rnams phyag na bum bsnams te/ /ye shes chu yis mngon par dbang bskur bas/ /rang gi rigs kyi gtsos brgyan cod pan gyur—/ /de bzhin rang gi lha 'dra rang snying pos/ /sprul pa'i rig pa nyid ni yang dag blta①/ /mig la sogs pa dgang zhing yi ge gsum/ /rnam par bkod pas lus ni 'od dang ldan/ /de nyid shes pas mgo dang snying ga dang / /lte ba gsang ba de bzhin brla gnyis sogs/ /oṃ hūṃ swā 26hā zhes grags pa rnams—/ /de ni sku thugs rdo rje bzang rigs sogs/ /lnga po rnams kyis yan lag byin brlabs te/ /'od kyi phreng ba dam pas 'gro gsum khyab/ /āḥ snayis sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba bya/ /hūṃ gis 'dab ma brgyad pa rnam par sprul/ /shes rab dam pa'i rgyu mthun ngo bo nyid/ /thabs dang bcas par 'byung ba'i rang gi lus—/ /de yis bde gshegs rjes su mnyes bya zhes/ /sngags pas dga' ba kun du brtsam par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā rkenu rā ga na ④badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa kolha④haṃ—/ thugs ka'i zla ba'i sngags kyi 'od rnams kyis/ /ma lus sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bcug nas ni/ /hūṃ gi rdo rje las byung dri ma med pa yi/ /yid tshul dam pa'i chu 'uskyes la gnas pa/ /rang gi snying po las byung ma lus pa'i/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor pa yi gzugs bsams la/ /cho ga 'di yis sems ni brtan po dang / /'jig rten rnams la phan phyir yang dag dbyung / /badz+ra j-ika ces bya dang thugs rdo rje/ /skye bo dam pa'i don mdzad yang dag bskul/ /nor bu sngon po'i 'od 'drar yang dag 'bar/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal ni dkar dang dmar/ /dam pa dang po lta bu'i phyag dang ldan/ /kha dog dpag 21—913

tu med pa'i 'od tshogs mnga'/ /blo dang ldan pas legs bsdus bdag nyid kyi/ /dngos po thams cad kyis ni zhugs par bya/ /dzi na dzika ces bya ba sku rdo rje/ /rdo rje 'dzin 'dra'i 1sku mdog zhal gyis mdzes/ /'khor lo la sogs phyag mtshan rnams de bzhin/ /shar gyi pad+mar zla ba'i dbus su bsam/ /rat+na dh+rika ces bya ba 'di yis ni/ / lho ru rin chen 'byung zhal gzhon nu 'dra/ /btso ma'i gser gyi mdangs dang 'dra ba la/ /phyag drug margad rin chen la sogs bsnams/ /ā ro t+paka snye'od dpag med pad+ma ni/ /rā ga ltar dmar zhal gnyis de dang 'dra/ /'od zer 'bar zhing phyag na pad+ma sogs/ /mtshan ma bsnams pa nub tu bsam par bya/ /pradz+nyā dh+rika ces bya bas ④don yod grub/ /rin chen margad lta bu'i mdog ldan zhing / /snga ma lta bu'i zhal sogs phun 3tshogs mnga'6/ /ral gri la sogs bsnams pa byang du bsam/ /ral pa cod pan mdzes dang sna tshogs pa'i/ /rin chen mchog gi 'od zer 'bar bas brgyan/ /rig ma'i 7mgon dang rab tu bcas pa'i sku/ /thams cad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dag la bsam/ /mo ha ra tī zhes pas lha mo spyan/ /zla ba'i kyedakyil 'khor rdzogs pa la gnas pa/ /mchog tu sgeg 9cing sku yi rdo rje 'dra/ /me yi phyogs nyid du ni bsam par bya/ /dz+wa ṣa ra tī zhezhes pa dga' ba che/ /dga' chen mchog 'dod mā ma k+to zhes pa/ /zhal mdzes phyag rnams thugs kyi gtso 'dra ba/ /rnam par sgeg pa bden bral mtshams su bsam/ /rā ga ra tī pya zhes bya'i yum mchog ni/ /gos dkar yon tan rin chen mtha' yas pa dri med sku ni gsung gi dbang phyug 'dra/ /rlung gi phyogs su rnam par bsam par bya / /badz+ra ra tīs gerab bskul sgol ma ni/ /dri med rin chen 'od kyi 21—914

—phreng ba yis/ /phyogs kyi tshogs khebs rang gi ngo bo ni/ /rin chen dbang 'dra dbang ldan phyogs su bsam/ /lha mo 'di rnams nges pa'i phyag mtshan ni/ /'khor lo bzang dang at+pal dmar po dang / /pad+ma at+pal gser mdog rim bzhin bsam/ /lhag ma rnams ni bdag po ji bzhin 'dod/ /de nyid gsum gyis gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /lha mo tshornams ni sku la sogs 'dra bar/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mtshams gyur bzhi po dang / /rtsa ba'i sgo yi ngos gnyis dag tu bsam/ /ya mān+ta kṛta 3ces byas gshin rje gshed/ /mtha' yas 'jigs 'od phyogs kun khyab dang ldan/ /dus mtha' mi bzad sprin gyi dkyil 'khor mdog /thugs kyi rgyal po dag dang sku mtshungs pa/ /drag po'i rigs 'od dpag med rnam 'phro bas/ /gshin rje mthar mdzad shin tu gdug pa yi/ /sbrul gyis lus kyi yan lag rnam brgyan pa/ /dpal ldan shar gyi sgor ni bsam par bya/ /pradz+nyān+ta kṛta ④ces byas bla med 'od/ /drag cing phyag sogs sku yi rdo rje 'dra/ /gzhan gyis mi thub ces bya gtum po ni/ /lho phyogs kyi ni sgo ru bsam par bya/ / pad+mān+ta kṛta dz+waces byas phyogs rnams kyi/ /'khor lo'i sna'od kyis mngon par khebs byed pa/ /'od mdangs 'jig dus me 7'drar 'jigs 3par ldan/ /phyag la sogs par gsung gi rdo rje 'dra/ /gdug pa du ma rnam gnon 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /thub dbang ha ha zhes ni bzhad pa yis/ /ri bor bcas pa sgyel bas skrag mdzad pa/ /rta mgrin de bzhin nub kyi phyogs su bsam/ /bispyon+ta ḍakṛta ces byas dpa' bo ni/ /dus mtha'i me ltar drag po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /'phags pa'i zhal snasogs mi bskyod dang mtshungs pa—/ /de bzhin byang gi sgo ru bsam par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad thugs 21—915

gtso 'od dpag med/ /thugs kyi dbang po rim bzhin cod pan yin/ /tho ba dbyug pa de bzhin pad+ma dang / /rdo rje sogs 'di phyag ni kun la bsam/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dngos po thams cad kyis ni bltas nas kyang / /snying po'i sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /drangs nas bde bar gshegs rnams bsgom par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dri med pa'i/ /ting 'dzin las byung dam pa'i bdes gang bar/ /'khor lo bsams nas de nas gshin rje ni/ /mthar byed la sogs bshad pas bsrung bar bya/ /rang gi snying pos mngon bzlas mchod yon ni/ /tsan+dan bzang sogs me tog gis mdzes dbul/ /rang las byas pa lta bur dbang bskur zhing //cho ga yis ni mngon par mchod par bya/ /pad nang rang gi sa bon 'di rnams kyis / /gzugs la sogs pa thams cad drangs nas ni/ /yang dag byang chub yid kyi ngo bo yisanyu/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom par bya/ /shes rab ba spu re re 2las byung ba'i/ /'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs rgya chen tshogs/ /ma lus nam mkha'i gtos ni kun du khyab/ /de la blo dang ldan pas rab tu spro/ /'od kyi sgo las nges par byung ba yi/ /yan lag dri med rgyan kun gyis legs brgyan / /me long pi wang dri dang ro yi snod/ /gos dang chos 'byung ba la sogs pa yi/ /mtshan mas rim gyis rnam par sgeg bcas shing / /rol bye pa'i lag pa dam pa rnams dang ni/ /'od kyi snang bas sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi dra bas khyab pa dang / /dngos rnams sgyu ma la sogs so sor ni / /yang dag rig cing 'jig rten blta rmyemakhas pa/ /rtog pa ma lus kun las nges grol zhing / /mchog tu bde ba bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /gzugs 21—916

la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin phyi yi dri sogs thams cad kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams ni legs mchod cing / /de ltar tha dad rtogs las 3 nges gol bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophobye haṃ/ sgra yi yul rnams ma lus pa rnams ni/ /brag ca'i sgra 'drar nges brtags de rjes la/ /rang 5yid lhag pa'i lha ru gnas pa la/ /chos rnams bstod pa'i sgra ni byed par bsam—/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rjer snyephyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal bo rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bar ba'i oṃ gyi byin rlabs 6rlung dang me'i/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas rab sbar bdud rtsi lnga/ /de nas yi ge gsum bzlas dpag med pa'i/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i nang du chud par bya/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bsams nas ni/ /hūṃ dgod rdo rje'i lce ni bzang po dang / /snying ga'i zla ba'i dbus su ma lus pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lo des ni tshim par bya/ /snying po'i 'od zer dpag med kyis sprul pa'i/ /thub pas mi shes kun du nges bsal ⑦ nas/ /'gro ba ma lus rdzogs sangs rgyas byas te/ /rang gi gsang 21—917

sngags nang du chud par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang bral bas /'dzin pa de ni mngon sum mthong mi nus/ /gzung ba rnams kyang cung zad yod min la/ /gzhan pa'i 'byel pa yis kyang mthong ba med/ /bde sogs de ni yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ /bya ba 'ga' yang yod par ma mthong ste/ /cig car shes pa'i phyir na gzugs sogs bzhin/ /'di dag 'dzin pa por ni yod ma yin—/ /dkar po la sogs gang zhig mthong ba rnams/ /de nyid dus gzhan dag tu mthong mi 'gyur/ /'di nyid rtag tu gcig la gcig 'gal ba/ /yin phyir bde ba la sogs dag dang mtshungs/ /thog mtha' la sogs bye brag snang bas na/ /gzugs la sogs pa 'di dag gcig ma yin/ /phra rab rnams kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /du ma'i gzugs su min pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /rdul phran cha shas med pa nyid kyang ni/ /phra rab du ma 'dus pa yin ①min pas/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor la sogs rang bzhin te/ /bsags pa 'ga' yang 'dir ni med par 'gyur/ /de bas 'dzin po la sogs dang bral bas/ /rang rgyud gzugs sogs brtags 2pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu dngos po ma lus pa/ /dri za'i grong khyer dag dang mtshungs pa yin/ /bdag dang bdag gi rnam rtog rgyun gyi ni/ /ngo bo bdag ༄ 7gis der ni 'khor ba ste/ /dag pa phyin ci log de med pa yi/ /ngo bo tsam kyis rnam par shes par bya/ /'dir ni zhi dang srid pa'i ngo bo dag /chos nyid kyis ni dbye ba 'ga' yang med/ /gang phyir gzung ba la sogs rnam pa dang / /bral bar thams cad du ③ni rtag tu grub/ /de ni snang ba'i rang bzhin kun rtog las/ /thams cad ci yang yod pa ma yin te/ /sems las gzhan pa dag ces bya ba ni/ /yod pa ma yin de phyir de bdag nyid/ /21—918

gang zhig gzugs la so sor zhugs gyur pa/ /de yi bdag nyid gang yin de nyid gzugs / /de bas thams cad khyad lkupar med par brtag /snang bar gyur pa'i yul rnams gang yin pa/ /gang zhig rtog pa'i gnas su gyur pa rnams/ /de de gnyis su spyor ba dang bral bas/ /des na rnam par dbye ba thams cad min/ /dad dang brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa dang / /de bzhin dran dang bsam gtan rnam thudag pa'ang / /sgo bzangs byesrung bar byed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab rnam ④dag ma lus yul du snang / /mtshan ma med pa'i dga' ba rnam dag pa/ /ma lus lha mo'i tshogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sems can don dang bdag dang rnam rtog dang / /'jug pa'i rnam shes rnam par dag pa yang me long sogs yid dri med ngo bo bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang rang bzhin te/ /de bzhin nyid ni rnam dag sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo 'di ni rnam par bzhugs / /gzugs la sogs pa'i 'khrul pa rnam bral bas/ /dri med phung po la sogs ngo bor grub/ /ser sna la sogs ldog par gyur pa ni/ /pha rol phyin pa dkar po'i chos rang bzhin/ /rnam rtog med par bdag gzhan don 'byung ba'i/ /rgyu nyid kyis ni khyede yang go rims 6bzhin/ /zab pa dang ni rgya che ba yis na/ /shes rab thabs kyi 7bdag nyid can sems yin/ /dam pa'i don du ci yang gzhan dag las/ /dbye med dbye ba med min mi 'dod de/ /gzhan du 'dzin pa las ni bzlog phyir dang / /de bzhin bye brag la sogs rtog bral yin/ /de ltar brtags nas rang 8/snying dri med pa/ /zla ba la gnas mtshan mar bsgom par bya/ /gsang sngags dam pa thig le'i gzugs su ni/ /rang yid 'od dang ldan par yongs su bsgom/ /sems de'i 'od zer dri med 21—919

pas sad pa'i/ /sgu gsung rdo rje'i lus ni mchog gyur pa'i/ /slar yang 'di nyid du ni nges bzhugs shing / /ye shes bdud rtsi 'bab par bsam par bya /nang gi lus dang de bzhin thams cad kyang / /de yis kun du mthar ni snang byas nas/ /ba spu re re'i khong las byung ba yi/ /'od ①kyis sna tshogs kun du dgang bar bya/ /yang na rang gi mtshan ma phra mo ni/ /'od ldan sna rtser gnas par thub pa yi/ /'khor lo nang du chud byas snyeng rje yis/ /nang gi shes rab dam pa nyin mtshan bsgom/ /mtshan ma brtan po mthong na spro ba ni/ /'od zer de yis sprul pa'i thub dbang dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs pa yi phyag mtshan rnams / /blo dang ldan pas yang dang yang du spro/ /yang na bzlas la rtse gcig sems nyid ni/ /dngos kun bdag nyid rang gi sems dbang po/ /rang gi sngags ni sna tshogs 'od ldan par/ /byas pas blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /srog dang rtsol 2ba shin tu ma bsdams par/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gsal bar brjod bya zhing / /sku sogs rim pa bzhin du yang na ni/ /cig car spro ba dag ni legs par bya/ /nam mkha'i ke gtos dang mnyam pa sku sogs pa'i/ /'od kyi sku yi snang bas yang 4dag dgang / /de nas snga ma bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi debakod pa kun du spro/ /yongs su sbas pa'i rig pa mchog rnams ni/ /bde chen babs ⑥pas gzhan gyi )dbang thob nas/ /rnam par sgeg pa'i thub dbang tshogs rnams ni/ /mthar ni rang gi lus la gzhug par bya//rang gi snying po'i de nyid nges rtogs pa'i/ /skyo bas sems kyi spyod pa zhum gyur na//rig pa'i tshogs kyis yang dag glur blangs pas/ /rab tu bskul nas yongs su mchod par bya/ /sems bzang po yi chu rgyun srog dang ni/ /rtsol sniba'i 'od kyi 21—920

lcags kyus drangs nas ni/ /cho ga ji bzhin sku rdo rje sogs la/ /nges par dbab pas rmyeskyo ba bsal bar bya/ / de ltar thang cig ngal bso — byas nas ni//sngar bshad cho ga yis ni de nyid shes/ /gsang sngags dam pa rgyun du bzla ba rteni//sngags pa'ang kun du chags pa med par bya/ /bstod dang mchod sogs gshegs su gsol ba dang / /sngags pas rab tu 'bad de rnams bya zhing / /oṃ la sogs par 'khor lo bsdus nas ni/ /sku la sogs pa brtag pa dag tu bya/ /de ltar de nyid mthong bas rnam grol ba/ /sems can khams rnams kun du dmigs nas ni/ /snying rjes ④'gro ba rnams la phan don du/ /smon lam rnams ni mngon sum nyid du bya/ /langs nas dag pa'i sems dpa' rang gi lha'i—/ /rnam pa'i nga rgyal yid la byas nas ni/ /kun du snang bar gnas pa'i yul rnams ni/ /snga ma bzhin du yul du yongs su bsgom/ /rang rang gi ni ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /rim bzhin sku la sogs pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur ni/ /chos nyid kyis na phan tshun khyad par med/ /phyin ci log gi rtog pa spangs pa yis/ /bya ba ma lus pa ni rdzogs par bya/ /de yi thub pa'i 'khor lo ma lus pa/ /mchod pa 'di ni kun du mchog yin no/ /bza' za'i tshe na snying ga'i zla ba la/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo rang gi gsang sngags kyis / /kun du dmigs te byang chub sems kyis snyeni/ /ngo bo nyid gyur 'od dang ldan par bsam/ /rang gi zas la de nyid gsum bzlas te/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis rnam dag pa/ /de yis sku yi rdo rje la sogs pa/ /lha rnams kun du tshim pa nyid du bya/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg cho gas bsgre bya zhing / /yid kyi'ang yid nyid kyis ni bya ba ste/ /phung po'i bud shing rnam par bsreg pa yi/ /21—921

ye shes 'bar ba bla na med par bshad/ /de ltar ma lus pa yi 'dod pa yis/ /bdag nyid dam ni gzhan dag rang rang gi/ /lha yi gzugs gyur pa la yang dag mchod—/ /dam tshig 'di ni bde gshegs rnams kyis gnang / /rjes su mthun pa'i 'gro ba'i don rnams ni/ /ma lus bde gshegs mchod par yang dag brtag /lus la sogs pa'i las rnams de dang de/ /rtag tu legs par mnyam par gzhag 1ste bya/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i sems ldan lus dang ni/ /ngag yid las rnams ci yang rung ba dag /phyag rgya dang ni sngags kyi rnam pa ru/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis de gsungs so/ /gang phyir dngos po gcig la'ang sna tshogs pa'i/ /kun du rtog 3pas bsags pa'i rnam pa las/ /sdug bsngal bde dang grol ba skyed byed pa'i/ /las kyi khyad par mang po 'byung bar 'gyur / /de bas lus sogs dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /rnam pa'i las rnams sems kyi dbang las gsungs/ /de ltar rnyog pa ma lus spangs pa yi/ /sems ni nag po'i las su ga la 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams la snying ga'i zla bar ni/ /snying pos sna tshogs rdo rje ji 1bzhin bsam/ /dpal ldan dam tshig rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'gro ba rang bzhin gyis dag rnam bsams la/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i 4dbus su ni/ /sngar gyi rim pas dbang bskur kun du blang //phyi rol gyi yang khrus kyi cho ga la/ /rim 'di khyad par du yang bsam par bya/ /thun mtshams su yang de bzhin mchod la sogs/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas brjod byas nas ni/ /snying ga'i nang du 'khor lo chud byas la/ /snying rje dang ni shes rab ldan par nyal/ /ldang ba'i dus su dam tshig lha mo yi/ /yang dag glu yis dpal ldan bsgul bas ni/ /langs na thub pas bzlas brjod la sogs 21—922

pa / /cho ga snga ma bzhin du bya ba yin/ /dngos grub thob pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas ni/ /de nyid gsum mchod byas nas rang gi sems/ /sngar bshad dkyil 'khor dag la gnas nas ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /bgegs rnams bdud rtsi thab sbyor 'khor lo yis/ /dbang bskur byas nas 'bad pa med par 'joms/ /gang zhig dbus su gnas par gyur pa yisagye / /'khor lo de yang de yi yin par 'gyur/ /tha mal rnam rtog rgyun las gzhan pa yi/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan ci'ang yod ma yin/ /de dang rnam par 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i sems/ /'di ni mngon sum du ni rtogs par 'gyur / /zab cing rgya che ba yi bdag nyid can/ /gang yin der ni kun rtog snang mi 'gyur/ /rig pa las ni gzhan du gyur pa dag /yod pa min par sngar ni bsgrubs pas na/ /gang zhig gang dang mi mthun pa dag tu/ /lan cig gyur pa'ang de bgrod rgyas gyur pa/ /mthong ba'i bslab —pa rnam par 'phel ba yis/ /rang gi mi mthun shin tu 'gag par byed/ /sbyin pa la sogs bdag med ldan pas kyang / /tha mal pa yi rang gi ngo bo las/ /rnam par ldog par mi 'gyur gang phyir 'dir/ /yod kyang de ni mi mthun 'gyur ma yin / /de ltar rtogs na snying rjer ldan pa dag /ye shes bsam yas skad cig gis sgrub pa/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po'i rang gi ni/ /ngo bo su zhig nges par sgom rjo mi byed/ /dri med blo yi 'od zer rnams kyis ni/ /mun pa thams cad rnam par sel byed pa/ /rnam par bstan pas mdzad pa 'dis mchog gi/ /bdag 'dra'i go skabs dag ni ga la yod/ /bla ma dam pa'i gzhung ni cung zad tsam/ /bzung ba gang yin de yang dang por ni/ /'ching 21—923

ba lhod ces bya bar grags pas na/ /des na 'di la shin tu 'bad pa yin/ /de ltar rnam par sbyar las legs byung ba'i/ /dge ba dri med gang des 'gro ba'i yid—/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mgon dang bcas pa der/ /gzhol bar gyur pas rtag tu bsgom rtepar shog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kun du bzang po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i rdul la reg pa/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal snga nas snyekyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dhā 1ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ④༄ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/9༷5 tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉rapal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// //〈〈snar 〉〉dpal gsang ba kyis mdzad pa'o// // pya〈〈snar 〉ra /9༷6 tsho—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacal/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ zu〈〈snar 〉thastan/ ④〈〈snar 〉shesag rngu〈〈snar 〉〉〉/9༷7 rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhugs/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉gipho/ —〈〈snar 〉〉yib/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbye/9 8 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ba'i/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyod/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉maradra/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/9༷9 ste〈〈snar 〉sngagazhugs/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhug ste/91༷ hūṃ 〈〈snar 〉zabags/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ rkye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṭ+wāṃ rdza/ ce〈〈pe 〉7) mig 〈〈snar 〉7)sa migade ce〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā paṃ tai/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsū sloṭī/ spu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉brtag —〈〈pe 〉masaḥ/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉gibyas par/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bya bar/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉masab/⑫〈〈snar〉rga/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7chi/ ⑩ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sinyen/911 1〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 1〈〈snar 〉thargyan/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ snye〈〈snar 〉rag6〈〈pe〉rgapho/ )〈〈pe〉7po/21—924
