༄khya/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kun du bzang mo zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tu dzā ñtshag sā dha māṃ no pi ka sa man+ta bha dī nā ma/ bod skad du/ yan lag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kun du bzang mo zhes bya ba / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'khrul pa kun bsal dri ma med pa yi/ /gzi brjid mtha' yas rigs kyi sprul pas rnam brgyan pa/ /shes rab ma yis 7lus 'khyud mdzes pas klubs pa gang / /'jam dpal de la de mchod don dngos cho ga 'di bshad bya/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i tshul gyis dam pa'i bshes gnyen gsol gdab phyabyed brod pas/ /'gro ba'i don kun phun sum tshogs gzhi dngos po cho ga bshad par bya/ /skabs ldan g.yo ba 'di dang dam pa'i skye bo dang 'grogs shin tu thob dka' 'jig rten la—/ /de phyir thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin byed 'dod sems ni mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /de nas snying rje'i mthu las byung ba'i byang chub yid ldan gsang 21—927

sngags pa/ /gtong ba la sogs yon tan brgyad pa zab mo'i tshul la mos pa'am /dpal ldan gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor cho gas shin tu dbang bskur phun sum ldan//cho ga bzhin du lung stsal thob pa bzhi sngags bsnyen pa blo ldan pas/ /gang zhig dri med chu sogs ljon shing mchog gi huphreng ba klubs pa yi/ /goms snyepa'i ri la bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs zhes bya rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /dang po tho rjo rangs snying ga'i dbus su dri med 'od 'phro de nyid bsam/ /bkod nas snying rje can gyis sgo la sogs pa yang dag par yang bya/ /dam pa'i tsan+dan sogs bkrus dri zhim me tog bkram pa'i mchog cha la/ /bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i gnas su 'dug nas dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /dmigs te sna tshogs mchod sprin spro sogs sngon du byas nas blo ldan pas/ /sdig pa la sogs 'di ltar bya'o dge ba 'phel don du/ /thog ma med ldan srid pa'i rgyun la rtog ④pas bsags pa'i sdig kun gang / /snying rje chen po'i mdun rim bzhin te thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /yang dag sangs rgyas byang chub 'phags dang gzhan rnams mdzad 5pa'i dge ba gang / /ma lus bdag gis yi rang yang dag de ni byang chub phyir bsngo'o / /sems rgyas zla ba dri ma med las grub pas mtha' yas snying rje gnas/ /bdag gi yid 6la gnas pa'i bde bar gshegs la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa kun las nges grol ma lus dam pa sems dpa'i bkra shis gzhi/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bor chos la bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /bcings pas yang dag spangs pa'i snying rje mchog gis drangs pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la gnas pa dam bcas tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam pa rnam ) smin dag pas sgrib kun bag chags ma lus bcom pa ste/ /mos pas rnam par 21—928

brgyan pa'i sems kyis byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas lam gcig sbyin sogs bcu po dkar po yon tan ngo bo la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dag kun gyi rang bzhin blo yis de ltar bsten par bgyi/ /'jig rten 'di dag lta ba'i dra bas bkab la snying rjes dmigs nas su/ /yang dag byang chub sems kyi gzhal med bsgom rim 'di ni sngags lkupas bya/ /stong pa rang bzhin med phyir rgyu 'bras phyir ni rang bzhin mtshan ma med/ /rjes su dpag pa bsal rgya bas ma lus gzhi yi smon pa nges bral lo/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kopho①haṃ/ de 'og ston zla dkar po mtha' med phyogs 'khor gnas pa sna tshogs 'od/ /'phags par gnas pa'i gru gsum nang gi mkha' yi rang bzhin rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos kyi 'byung zhes phyag rgya dbus ④gnas pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /hūṃ gis rdo rje brgyan 3pa'i sa la kun du bzang po las byung bsgom/ /zlo rngo yig 'khor lo las byung rig ma dang bcas snang mdzad skur gyur pa/ /gsal ba thub dbang dkyil 'khor sna tshogs 'od zer kyis khyab phyogs 'khor kun/ /gru bzhi dz+wamanyam pa'i phyir na mchog bzhis dran pa dbang po sgo rnams kyis/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi twar ṇa ting 'dzin mu khyud bzhi yis yongs bskor ba/ /mu khyud de la gnas pa dam pa'i mchod pas 'byel pa'i gzugs rnams rgyun/ /sna tshogs rgyan rnams bkod pa 'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs phyir/ /'dul bas bskyod pa gsung rab yan lag dgu yi dam chos kun 'gro ci yi phyir/ /rlung gis bskyod pa rgyal mtshan phreng dang dril sgra grag pas phyogs sgo kun/ /me long ye shes rtag tu dri med byang chub yan lag me tog spos bkram zhing / /dra ba dra phyed me long me tog phreng ba sna 21—929

tshogs brgyan pa'i gzugs/ /rnam par thar brgyad rnam par dag pas ka ba brgyad kyis klubs 1pa'i mchog /rdo rje tshul gyis chos kyi 'khor los sgyur phyir rdo rje'i thig ldan la/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i spyod yul dag pas bla med mtha' yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /zas lngas brgyan pas rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings rgyu mthun/ /sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas nyi ma zla bar bcas pa lha yi gdan//ma lus rin chen bkod pa'i gzhal yas brtsegs pa de la bsgom/ /bcu drug cha shas sde pa las byung zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pa yi dbus/ /dbus kyi gdan la cho ga bzhin du 'od dpag med gzhi tsabasam par bya/ /mchog gi dang po'i snying po las byung rdo rje dam pa ye shes gzugs/ /grangs med thug pa'i ge'od zer phreng bas grub pa'i phyogs sgo kun/ /bsams rgenas dang po'i snosnying por bcas pa'i nga rgyal ldan pas sprul pa mtha' yas kyis/ /'gro ba'i don mchog rab mdzad pa yi thugs mchog rdul phran rnam bkod gzugs brnyan can/ /g.yas g.yon zhal ni gnag dang dmar po zla ba rdzogs ltar dkar ba'i mdog /gsal bas durnam par bkod pas brgyan pa'i phyag gnyis dam pa'i rig ma 'khyud/ /lhag ma'i phyag zung gnyis brgyan rdo rje ral gri rin chen pad+ma 'dzin/ /'jig rten gsum khong brgyan pa'i 'od zer rnam pa bde 'gro thub pa'i dbang / /rnam thar gsum dag shes rab bdag nyid snying rje'i mchog gi thabs ldan pas/ /'gro kun de nyid gcig pa rgyal ba skyed byed sku bzhi mngon sum bya/ /mchog tu rjes chags phun sum tshogs pas 'jig rten thams cad 'dul dmigs nas/ /dga' ba'i rdzu 'phrul sgra yis rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rang gi lus nang bzhugs3/ /de ni spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo gzugs sogs yul gyi rang bzhin pas/ /phyung nas 21—930

rig ma thams cad gzhi yi rig ma'i nang du thim par bya/ /de yi pad+ma'i snying po'i dbus su dkyil 'khor dri med zla 'od las byung ba/ /blo tshoyis bsams nas rdzogs par bde la skye bo'i tshogs rnams gzhug par bya/ /dam pa gsang ba'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnam snang mdzad sogs rgyal ba'i rgyan byezhugs nas/ /zla ba zhu ba'i ngo bor gyur pas dbang bskur byas te de 'og tu/ /sa snying phyag na rdo rje nam snying 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib pa sel/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po de dag mig la sogs pa'i grangs su gyur/ /gzugs sgra dri dang ro dang reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje yang / /sa chu me rlung rang bzhin gyur pa spyan la sogs pa'i grangs ②'gyur ro/ /gzugs dang myong ba mtshan ma de bzhin kho na 'du byed yid brjod pas/ /rnam snang mdzad sogs bde gshegs rnams te de 'og sa bon gyis dbyung bya/ /spyo dz+rī ④khaṃ shaṃ sko saṃ ltabarjod pa de dag mig la sogs rnams so/ /myong ba mtshan ma de bzhin kho na 'du byed yid brjod pa/ /rnam snang mdzad sogs bde gshegs dzaḥkhyehūṃ baṃ hoḥ gekhaṃ re brjod pas gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs so/ /waṃ rmā paṃ t+t+waṃ 3zhes kyang gsungs pa de bzhin spyan la sogs pa'o/ / rgyu māṃ dz+rī ⑨hūṃ zhes pas rtag pa du la sogs so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes sems 'bar ho yi bar du zhugs pa cho ga bzhin/ /pad+ma'i nang gnas 11mnyam med shes rab chags pas zhu ba byed mthong ste/ /de yi 'od kyi mthu yis kyang ni zla ba 4zhu bar byed mthong ste/ /'di ltar spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo'i zhedabyangs kyi sgra yis bskul bar bsam/ sems can khams na gnas pa'i dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs—/ /dga' ba ⑫yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol//mgon po gal te de ⑪ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can 21—931

yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i 1sku khyod bka' yi 'khor los 2sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog sgrub rab tu phan par gzigs/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan pa'i thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgongs pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /spyod pa dri med kun du bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /byed ni rdo rje'i 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de ltar dbyangs kyis bskul bas sgyu 'phrul dra bar dngos kun legs bsams nas/ /'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba'i gzhi yi ①sngags kyis lus su rang bsgyur bya/ /de la 'od kyis ④ma lus lha rnams rgyal ba'i thub dbang rnams—/ /nang du thim nas 'od kyis thudapal ldan 9'jam pa'i rdo rjer gyur par bya/ /gur kum mchog 'od dmar 'dra g.yas g.yon zhal ni gnag dang dkar ba'i mdog /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i phyag gnyis dam pa'i shes rab 'khyud/ /gsal ba'i ral gri mda' dang at+pal mthing ga gzhu ni mtha' yas 'od/ /ma lus rigs rnams 'phro bas brgyan pa'i mkha' kun dkyil 'khor ldan skyob pa/ /gzung 'dzin bral bas dngos po thams cad ngo bo nyid med shes nas su/ /rnam par byang ba mngon bzhugs zab don byin brlabs 21—932

'di ltar bya/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahūṃhaṃ/ de 'og gzhi yi sa bon 'od kyis pya ji ltar rang la gang ste mig sogs rnams/ /sa snying la sogs dri med rang snying zla ba'i rdo rje bum pa'i dkyil gnas pa/ /hūṃ gi thugs kyi rdo rje kha dang mgo la pad+ma 'khor lo'i dkyil du yang / / aXdang phyag mtshan ④gnyis kyis gsung gi rdo rje sku yi rdo rje'ang bsam par bya/ /de thugs 'od zer rgyun gyis rang gi shes rab dang sbyor snang bas kun du ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams la mchod nas thugs kyi rdo rje la sogs byin gyis brlab/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas5/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes 4mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa a ko3 muhaṃ/ dpal ldan chos kyi gsung gi lam/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /gsung gi rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams—/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas 5/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /gsung gi /rmye rdo rjes mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kopho tshuhaṃ/ dpal ldan sgu yi rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms skyepas/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas kyi/ /sku yi rdo rjes ⑩mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas ④/ /de ring bdag la byin brlabs nas/ /sgu yi rdo rjes ⑫ mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma 21—933

kophonyuhaṃ / rdo rje gsum ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin mtshan ma spangs pa mtshon byas te/ /sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis bskul nas thams cad tshogs su gyur pa'i thub pa'i sde/ /thub mchog 'od zer las byung rig ma'i tshogs kyis ke yang dag 'dzin pa yi/ /bum pa'i ye shes chu yis blugs pas rang rig gtso bo snang bas dbu brgyan gyur/ /de bzhin rang gi lha mo 'dra bar rang gi snying po'ang bsgoms nas rig mar sprul/ /mig la sogs pa gang nas yig 'bru gsum bkod 'bar ba'i lus ldan ma/ /'og snying lte ba gsang ba de bzhin brla gnyis sogs la de nyid shes par bya/ /oṃ hūṃ swā 26hā zhes bya bas zhulus yid rdo rje dam pa'i rigs tshogs kyi4/ /de lnga'i byin rlabs lus ni 'go gsum khyab pas dam pa'i 'od tshogs bsam/ /s+dzacho sa bskyed rnam par bkod pa'i snying po hūṃ las sprul pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /pad+ma'i shes rab rgyu mthun rang bzhin thabs dang bcas par gyur pa'i gzhi yi tre lus bsngags pa/ /de dang lhan cig bde gshegs rnams la rjes su chags par bgyi zhes brtsams/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā 7nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kopho haṃ/ sems kyi zla ba'i 'od kyis ma lus sangs rgyas tshogs ni bzhugs gnas te/ /t+t+waṃ gi rdo rjer byung nas dri med pad+ma la gnas dam pa'i yid kyi gzugs/ /bsams nas rang gi snyeng bos bskyed pa thams cad gzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha gzugs su/ / ṭumachog gi rjes su dkar mo zhes par mtha' yas yon tan rin chen ma/ /rin chen dbang phyug dra ba'i dngos po sgrol ba badz+ra ra tī sbyizhes bsgul bas/ /dri med rin chen phreng bas bsgoms pa'i phyogs 'khor byed ma dbang ldan la/ /dam pa'i 'khor lo ut+pal dmar po pad+ma ut+pal ser po rnams kyis mtshan/ /de dag gi ni rim pa'i 21—934

nges pa'i lhag ma'i ji ltar 'dod pa'i phyag bsnams yin/ /dkyil 'khor grwa bzhi dang ni shar kyi sgo gnyis la ni bsam bya ba/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mo sku la sogs dang gsum gyis so/ /shar gyi sgo ru grags pa bsam pa thams cad 'grub mtha' yas pas 'jigs pa'i 'od/ /'bar la ya mān+ta kṛta tshoces pas zad dus drag sprin dkyil 'khor dngos po ste/ /thugs bdag rgyal po mnyam pa'i sku ni du ma'i khro bo rigs kyi 'od byung ba/ /gshin rje mthar byed ces bya mi bzad kyepa yi sbrul gyis sku brgyan dpal ldan pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor gnas pa pradz+nyān+ta kṛta ces pas bla na med ldan pa/ /sku yi dbang phyug bzhin du phyag la sogs pa drag po gzhan gyis mi thub gsal/ /de nas rta mgrin nub kyi phyogs su 1sgo ru 'od zer 'khrigs pas phyogs bskor ba/ /pad+mān+ta zikṛta ces pas 'bar ba'i 'jig phyepa'i me ltar 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gsung gi bzhin du phyag la sogs pa du mas sdang ba 'jigs byed zhal/ /gad sgrogs bzhad pas ri rnams g.yo bar byed dang thub pa'i dbang rnams so/ /de nas mi bskyod 'dra ba'i zhal sogs bispyon+ta kṛta ces bya byang sgo ru/ /zad dus byin za lta bu 'phags pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dpa' ba'o/ /rnam snang mdzad dang thub dbang snang ba mtha' yas thugs kyi dbang phyug dbu rgyan dang / /rim par tho 6ba be+e con pad+ma rdo rje la sogs phyag kyang de bzhin no/ /de ltar rdzogs par bskyed par dkyil 'khor mthong nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /snying po sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyus bde gshegs spyan drangs bsgom par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab dngos po dri med ting 'dzin las byung dam pa'i bde bas gsang bar ni/ /dkyil 'khor bsams te de nas mthar byed la sogs bsrung byas nas/ /rang snying bzlas 21—935

pa'i 7tsan+dan sogs dang me tog mdzes pa phul te thim/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i cho gas dbang bskur byas nas 'di ltar nan tan mchod par bya/ /pad+ma'i nang gi rang gi sa bon 'od kyis drangs nas gzugs sogs 3thams cad ni/ /pad+ma'i 'od zer dkyil 'khor yang dag byang chub yid kyi sa bon bsam par bya/ /shes rab so so'i ba spu'i snalas byung sna tshogs rnam pa'i 'od zer rgyas pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus khyab pa'i mkha' gzhi thams cad de nas blo ④dang ldan pas spro bar bya/ /'od zer sgo nas byung ba'i dri med thams cad rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan sku dang / /me long pi wang dri dang ro yi snod dang na bza' chos 'byung la sogs dang / /mtshan ma rnams kyi rim pas mdzes pas ldem bag phyag ⑤ni lo ma 'od dang bcas/ /gsal ba'i 'od zer sprul pa mang po sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi dra ba rnams 'byung dang / /sgyu ma la sogs dra ba'i dngos po so so yang dag rig pa'i 'jig rten lta dge dang / /rtog pa thams cad nges grol mchog gi bde ba 'byung rgyu'i dngos ldan pa'i/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis de bzhin phyi ma'i dri sogs thams cad kyis/ /dbye ba'i rtog pa grol bas rgyal ba'i dbang po rnams la yang dag mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kopho ⑥haṃ/de yi 'og tu sgra brnyan 'dra bar sgra yul thams cad la ni yod bsams na/ /rang yid rig pa'i lha yi stong rtsepa'i sgra dang ldan pa'i chos rnams zhes su gsungs/ /gzugs la sogs pa gcig min rdul phran cha yang ma mthong du ma'i gzugs kyang ma yin zhes pa'ang de bzhin no/ /yan lag med pa'i rdul phran nyid la du ma'i rdul phra rab kyi bye rjes 'brang med phyir dang / /sa yi dkyil 'khor la sogs gzugs kyi dbye bas de la 'ga' yang mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas 'dzin pa la sogs 21—936

bral bas rang dbang gzugs la sogs pa kun brtags ngo bo yin/ /ma lus g.yo dang mi g.yo'i dngos po dri za'i grong khyer dag dang 'dra ba yin/ /bdag gir 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'i turgyun kyi ༄ —ngo bos 'khor ba 'di dag ste/ /dag pa yang ni de las ldog pa'i ngo bo tsam la rnam par shes par bya/ /chos nyid kyis ni srid dang zhi ba'i ngo bo 'dir ni dbye ba 'ga' yang med/ /ci'i phyir 'dzin pa la sogs rnam par bral ba rtag tu kun la sgrub pa'i phyir/ /thams cad 'ga' yang med de so sor snang ba'i rang bzhin rtog pa las/ /sems las gzhan du gyur pa'i nga zhes 'ga' yang med de de phyir bdag kyang de/ /gang gi ngo bo gang yin de yis sgo dade nyid rtogs pa'i gzhi ste ci phyir dngos/ /de bas thams cad dbyer med shes te dngos po thams cad dbyer med pa nyid yin/ /kha byug yul dang kha cig gzhan du snang bar rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa gang zhig gis/ /de dang de yi bral dang bral ba'i phyis te de phyis thams cad ma yin no/ /dad dang brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa de bzhin dran pa bsam gtan dag pas kyang / /dam pa'i sgo srung gzugs te shes rab rnam par dag pas thams cad yul du snang //mtshan ma sked pa'i dag pa thams cad dag pas lha mo tshogs kyi rang bzhin dang / /thams cad don dang bdag po rnam par rtog pa rab tu 'jug pa rnam par dag pa yis—/ /me long la sogs mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum / /rdo rje dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che//rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin gyis —ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zabaskye/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med—/ /dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sgu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /21—937

rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal 'bar bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rlung me'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'bar ba'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga la de nas 'bru gsum bzlas pa'i dkyil nas grangs med thub pa'i dbang / /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin brtsams te yi ge hūṃ bkod rdo rje dam pa'i lce/ /snying ga'i zla ba'i dbus su ma lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de yis tshim par bya/ /kun du 'khrul pa spangs pa'i snying gi 'od zer las byung thub dbang mtha' yas kyi/ /'gro ba ma lus yang dag sangs rgyas byed pa bzhi yi sngags nang thim par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i rnam par grol bas mngon sum gyis ni mthong min de 'dzin pa/ /gzung ba 'ga' yang med de gzhan yang yod pa ma yin 'byel pa ma mthong bas/ /sim pa la sogs rang gi las kyang 7'ga' yang ma mthong de yongs bzung bas na/ /dus gcig 'brel par gyur pa gzugs la sogs pa bzhin du de dag gzung 'dzin med/ /dkar po la sogs gang gis dang por mthong ba de nyid dus gzhan mthong ba min/ /de gnyis phan tshun du yang mi mthun phyir na rtag tu sim la sogs pa bzhin/ /de nas bzlas pa byed 'dod sems kyis dngos kun bdag nyid rang sems bdag por ni/ /byas nas sems kyi 'od zer ldan pa bzhi yi sngags ni mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /'phro bas sngags kyi rgyal po gsal bar gtong dang dgag pa'i dbang du byas nas bzlas nas su/ /sku la sogs pa rnams kyi spro ba'i rim gyis sam ni dus gcig byas pa 21—938

yis—/ /nam mkha'i nang du sku la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis bkang tshobya ste//gong ma bzhin du sna tshogs mchod sprin tshogs rnams de nas kun du dbyung bar bya//mchog gi rig ma 'khyud pa bde ba chen po chags pas gzhan dbang mthong nas su//rgyas pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyun ni rang gi lus la mthar ni thim par bya/ /gzhi yi snyeng po de nyid sems dpas lus nyams 2zhan pas sems kyi spyod chung ba//rig ma mchog gi dbyangs kyis sprerab tu gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor mchod par bya'o/ /dam pa'i sems kyi chu rgyun 'gags 3pa'i dbugs kyi 5'od zer lcags kyus drangs nas su/ /lus nyam chung na cho ga bzhin du sku yi rdo rje sogs la dbab par bya/ /de ltar skad cig 'dug nas gong nas gsungs pa'i cho ga yis ni de bzhin nyid shes pas/ /dam pa'i sngags kyis bzlas pa nyin mtshan med par bya'o sngags kyang ma 'dres pa'o/ /gsungs pa'i bstod tredang mchod la sogs pa rdzogs par bskyed pa brtson pa'i sngags pa yis/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sku la sogs par rtog pa bsgom 4par bya'o/ /de 'dra'i cho ga de du/nyid mthong bas sems can khams ni nges dgrol dmigs nas su / /snying rjes 'gro la phan don brtan pa'i sems kyis cho ga 'di yis 'jig rten phan pa'i rgyu phyir 'byung bar bya/ /badz+ra j-ika ces bskul nas thugs kyi rdo rje 'gro ba'i don mchog byed pa ni/ /g.yas g.yon zhal ni dkar dmar 'bar ba'i mthing ga dam pa nor bu 'dra ba'i mdog /mchog gi dang po bzhin du phyag dang ldan pa du ma'i mdog gi 'od kyi rngo/tshogs/ /'dus nas bdag la blo dang ldan pas dngos po kun gyis thim par bya/ /dzi na dzika ces bskul ba'i rdo je 'dzin ltar mdog dang zhal sogs ldan/ /shar gyi zla ba pad+ma'i dbus su 21—939

'khor sogs mtshan pa de bzhin bsam/ /rat+na dh+rika ces lho ru rin chen dbang phyug zhal rnams gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra ba/ /btso ma'i gser dang 'dra ba margad rin chen la sogs mdzes pa'i phyag drug pa/ /ā —1ro t+paka ces pad+ma rā 2ga bzhin du dmar la zhal gnyis de bzhin te/ /snang ba mtha' yas 'bar ba 'od ldan nub tu pad+ma la sogs mtshan pa'i phyag /ma ra ga ༄ ta'i nor bu lta bu 4sngon bzhin la sogs phun sum tshogs ldan pa/ /byang du don yod ces pa pradz+nyā 5dh+rika ces ral gri la sogs rnam ldan pa/ /mdzes pa'i ral pa'i dbu rgyan sna tshogs rin chen 'od kyis rab brgyan pa/ /rig ma dang bcas lus can thams cad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ni bsam par bya/ /me yi phyogs mtshams su ni mo ha ra tre+e 7zhes pas lha mo spyan mar gyur/ /bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas mchog gi 'jo sgeg sku yi rdo rje'i mdog /bden bral dag la sgeg mo thugs kyi dbang phyug lta bur mdzes pa'i zhal/ /dre 3/ṣa ra tī kyezhes pas dga' ba mchog tu spro ba mā ma shī zhes bya/ /ngag dbang dri med sku ni rā ga ra tī bhe zhes ni re zhig bsam pa la/ /sems kyi dri med ngo bo nyid pas sangs rgyas kun gyi gzugs/ /de nyid dag dang spyor bas dkyil 'khor bdag po nyid du cher gnas de dag go/ /gzugs sogs 'khrul dang bral bas dri med la sogs dngos grub pa'o/ /ser sna la sogs 'das pas grub pa'i pha rol phyin dang sa dang dkar ba'i chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam par rtog med bdag gzhan 'byung ba'i rkyen nyid rim pa la'o/ /zab cing rgya che nyid kyang thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid du ni sems pa'o/ /don dam par yang dbyer med dbyer med ma yin kha cig 'dod de gzhan phyir na/ /gzhan du gzung ba'i gnas med phyir dang de 21byed9/0

bzhin dbye sogs rtogs rtepa'i mi 'byor phyir/ /de ltar brtags nas zhi ba'i snying po dri med zla bar gnas pa'i mtshan ma'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /dam pa'i sngags kyi thig le'i dugazugs su rang gi sems ni 'od ldan bsgom par bya/ /sems de'i 'od zer phreng bas sku gsung rdo rje mchog gi lus la gsal byas nas/ /de nas lus nang thams cad gsal bar byas nas kun du de nyid mtha' yas pas//so sor ba spu las byung 'od kyi sde yis sna tshogs kun du gang byas te/ /slar yang de nyid du ni thim ste ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni bsgom par bya/ /yang na rang gi phyag mtshan phra mo gsal ba sna rtser gnas par bsgom par bya/ /nang du thub pa'i dkyil 'khor snying rje can gyis nyin mtshan dam pa'i shes rab ldan/ /brtan pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas spro ba de yi 'od zer thub dbang las byung dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs phyag mtshan rnams kyang yang dang yang du blo dang ldan par bya/ /bsdu ba bsngo dang smon lam rnams ni sngon du bya/ /langs nas dag pa'i sems dpa' rang gi lha yi rnam pa 'dzin pa'i sems ldan pa/ /yul las gsal ba la gnas gong ma bzhin du yongs su bsgoms nas yul rnams kyang / /sku la sogs pa'i rdo rjer gyur pa go rims jerang gi rang bzhin dag pa yis/ /chos nyid kyis ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bur gzhan dang gzhan du dbyer med chos / /thams cad bya ba bya'o phyin byu log pa'i rtog pa las rgo grol ba yi/ /thub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa'i mchog 'di dag gis rtag tu de 5yis so/ /bza' ba'i dus na snying ga ru ni gzhi yi sa bon rnams ni dmigs nas su/ /byang chub sems dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin kun du 'od zer 'bar ba bsam par bya/ /thams cad mnyam nyid dag pa'i bza' ba de nyid gsum gyi 21—9 11

—sngags ni gdab byas te/ /des ni sku yi rdo rje la sogs lha rnams rab tu tshim par bya/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg cho ga rjes su dpag tsam yid las byung ba'i sems nyid de/ /phung po la sogs bud shing bsregs nas ye shes me sbar ba ni bla sped gsungs / /de ltar thams cad 'dod pa rnams kyis bdag la rang rang lha yi gzugs nyid la/ /mchod par bya ba gzhan yang dam tshig der ni bde bar gshegs rnams 'dod pa yin/ /rjes su rig pa 'gro ba'i don dang bde gshegs kun la mchod pa yang byas te/ /lus la sogs pa'i las kyang de bzhin rtag tu mnyam par gzhag /par bya ba yin/ /de 'dra'i durnam pa'i sems la 'ga' zhig lus ngag dngos kyi las ni gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad phyag rgya'i sngags kyi rnam par sangs rgyas kyis ni gsungs pa yin/ /gcig pu kho na'i gzhi la sna tshogs rtog ④pas bsags pa'i rnam pa de rnams ni/ /sdug bsngal bde ba grol ba bskyed pa las ni 4khyad par ci yi phyir/ /dge dang mi dge'i rnam pas lus la sogs pa sems kyi dbang gi phyir zhes gsungasabye / /bde bas nyes pa thams cad spangs pa'i sems la nag po'i lus su gyur/ /dam tshig zad ma thag tu ji bzhin snying zlar bzhag pa'i rdo rje rgya gram sems/ /dpal ldan dam tshig rdo rje'i spyor bas rang bzhin rnam dag 'gro ba bsams nas ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su gong ma'i rim pas dbang bskur ba ni bsgom par bya/ /phyi yi 3khrus kyi cho ga la yang rim pa 'di dag khyad par du ni bsam srid kyi/ /mtshams la'ang de bzhin mchod pa la sogs sngon du byas nas bzlas byas te/ /sems kyi nang du gnas pa'i 'khor los shes rab snying rjer ldan pas nyal bar bya//tho rangs sde langs pa'i dus na lha mo rnams kyi dbyangs kyis bskul nas dpal ldan 21—942

pas—/ /byas nas langs te thub pas bzlas pa la sogs gong ma'i cho ga nyid kyis bya/ /grub pa'i mtshan ma thob pas de nyid gsum gyi mchod pa'i cho ga byas nas zhi sems la/ /gong nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pas ni 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'grub/ /bdud rtsi zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor la ni dbang bskur byas te nan tan dgra 2gzhom bya/ /gang zhig de yi dbus la gnas te gyur pa de ni de yi 'khor lo yin/ /sgyu ma rnam par rtog par gyur las gzhan 'ga' 'ang srid pa'i sdug bsngal yod pa med/ /de dang mi mthun pa ni de dag sems dpa' mngon sum du ni byang chub shes par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid de la gang yang snang ba ma yin rtog med pas/ /kun rdzob pa las lhag pa gzhan ni med do zhes te grub par sngar byas so/ /gang dag gang zhig mi mthun dus gcig 'gyur ba de gsal mchog gyur ci yi phyir/ mthong ba goms pa 'phel ba'i phyir na rang gi mi mthun gtan du 'gag pa yin/ / rgyu yi gzhi yi 2ngo bo rnams la bdag med ldan yang sbyin la sogs pa ni/ /'gog pa ma yin ci'i phyir bden yang de las log par mi byed do/ /de ltar shes nas snying rje ldan pas rdzogs chen ye shes rab tu 'grub pa'i sems/ /dpal ldan kun du bzang po gzhi yi dngos po gang gis bsgom par mi bya'o/ /dri med blo gros 'od zer kyis ni mun pa thams cad spong bar byed rnams kyis/ /rnam par mdzad la de ni bdag 'dra'i go skabs ga la yin te gzhag par bya/ /skye bo bla ma'i 'dod pa gang la 'ga' zhig dang por de ni gzung byas nas/ /bcings pa grol 'dod ci yi phyir na de'i phyir bdag gis sems khral 4'di byas so/ /de ltar byas pa las byung dge ba dri med gang yin de yis 'gro yid ni/ /sangs rgyas ye 21—943
