mdog gser btso ma 'dra ba/ gsus pa rab tu che ba/ sangs rgyas lnga'i rin po che'i cod pan dang lha'i ras kyis brgyan pa/ rgyan ma lus pas brgyan pa/zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa na bī phyadza pū ra 'dzin pa/ g.yon ne+e'u le'i kha nas 'bab pa'i 2rin po che yod pa rngo 'dzin pa/ at+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba can 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'khrigs pa/ zhabs kyi 'og na rin po che'i snye ma'i bum pa yod pa/ steng gi ngos gnyis na rin po che'i snye ma las nor gyi char 'be+ebs pa'am/ 'bebs pa'i gnod sbyin gnyis so/ /'di lta bu rab tu gsal bar bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i dze+e yig las 'od zer 'phros pas / de dang 'dra ba'i 'phags pa dze+e bha la mdun gyi nam mkha' la gnas pa la / mchod pa dngos dang yid las byung bas mchod la/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod de/ gnyis su med par byas la gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum dang / phyag rgyas brgyan no/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs te gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma dang / gsum pa bkug pa 'di ni phyag rgya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur te rin chen rdo rje dbu rgyan du bsam mo/ /de nas dgod pa ni/spyi bor oṃ/ kha la dze+e/ dpung pa g.yas pa la bha/ g.yon pa la la/ snying gar dza pya/ brla g.yas pa la lenabye/ g.yon pa la dra/ gsang gnas su ye/byin pa dag la swā/ rkang mthil dag la hā dgod do/ /de nas ser sna can dang dbul po rnams la dmigs/ spro bsdu ci nus bya ste duyid skyo na sngags bzlas so/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ dge ba ji ltar 'dod par bsngos la btang khyango / /langs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ci rigs par klag byego/ /phyi rol che chung byas nas khrus bya'o/ /mnyam par 'jog tsa na yi 21—1006

ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o/ /'di ltar thun mtshams gsum mam bzhir bya'o/ /thun mtshams re re la yang dang po dang tha mar mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la thun tha ma la gshegs su gsol zhing / thun dang po la spyan drangs te/ mchod pa yang dngos su ma 'byor na yid kyis bya'o/ /gtor ma yang thun mtshams thun mtshams kyi dang po 'jug ka 'jug kar sbyin no/ /yang nas yang du spyod lam gyi bya bar chu dbul ba dang / mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad gdon no—/ /yang na bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i rnam 'byor du gnas pas ①bzlas pa dang bstod pa dang chu dbul bas bsgrub ste/ de'i rim pa yang 'phags pa dze+e bha la'i lugs ma rab tu gnas par byas la bya/ gong ngam nyi ma'i rtse la snod bzang po gas chag dang bug rdol med par de bzhugs la bstod pa dang bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ de nas chu phul la dngos grub gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas yang za ma tog ser po dri zhim pos bkang bar sba'o/ /de la chu dbul ba'i man ngag ni zla ba dang rdo rje bsam/ yi ge e las gdu bu ni/ /so sor mkhrig mar bsam par bya/ /baṃ ni zla ba'i mdog can te/ /de las bdud rtsi rab 'bab pa/ /dri med ser po mngon phyogs pas/ /mkhas pas bum pa bzhin du blta/ /mdzub mo la ni nor bu bzang / /gang bzang rtezhes bya gung mo la'o/ /srin lag la ni nor sbyin te/ /nor sbyin chen po mthe chung la/ /mthe bor pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ /ki sneli ma li mkhrig ma ste/ /sgo dbang spyod pa'i dbang po dag /lag pa'i ngos la rnam par bsam/ /sngags pas gnod 'dzin chu dbang ni/ /lag pa'i dbus su rnam bzhag ste/ /rang rang sngags kyis rim bzhin bsam/ /dang po yi ge oṃ ④dang ni/ /rat+na khrubadz+ra rang ming 21—1007

ldan—/ /bzhi yi mtha' dang de bzhin du/ /swā hār bcas pa ①sngags su grags—/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi lag par bsam/ /ji ltar spyi bor cho ga bzhin/ /mkhas pas chu yi sbyin blugs brgya/ /nyin re bzhin ni ⑤legs par dbul/ /zhes so/ /dmar dang ser dang ser po dang / /sngo dang dmar dang ljang gu dang / /ser po dag dang gser mdog dang / /de dag gis ni kha dog bstan//g.yas na lcags kyu zhags pa dang ne+e'u le/ g.yon bī dza pū ger dang rdo rje lcags kyu dang / ne+e'u le can gyi lag pa stan 0la brten pa'o/ /de nas bzlas pa'i sngags ni ji ltar bkod pa nyid dam/ yang na dze+e bha la swā hā zhes pa'o/ /chu dbul ba'i sngags ni ji ltar btus pa nyid dam yang na bzlas pa'i sngags kyi mjug la/ dha rgo me de hi swā hā zhes pa spel ba'am/ yang na oṃ dh+ri rja swā hā zhes pa'o/ /yang na oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ⑤dha rgo me de hi swā hā zhes pa'o/ /chu dbul ba na yang gtso bo la khyor ba'am snyim pa brgya rtsa brgyad dbul zhing gnod sbyin brgyad po la yang snyim pa re re'am gsum gsum mam bdun yan chad dbul lo—/ /dbul ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyis ci bde bar ro/ /kha zas za ba na yan lag la lha rnams dgod do/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza led+dhā ya 'u/swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dru ya swā hā/ oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba rja ya swā hā/oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li de swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā pyali rgo swā hā/ oṃ mu khed+dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa rebye ya swā hā/ thams cad kyi swā hā'i sngon du dha rgo me de ti zhes pa spel lo/ /chu phul nas 'khor lo la thim pa'am gshegs su gsol lo/ /spyor ba 'dis tshe 'di nyid la dbul ba 'dor ba dang 'byor pa mi zad ⑧pa 'thob bo/ /sbyor ba 'dir spudaman pas kyang srid pa gzhan la 'byor pa mtha' med par 'gyur ro/ /21—1008

—longs spyod rnams dkon mchog dang pha ma dang bla ma dang sbug bsngal ba rnams la zad par bya bar bsam zhing zad par yang bya'o/ /gzhan du na 'grub pa med do//nan tur du bya bar rigs pas nan tur du byed na rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas spra tshil las byas pa'i mtshan ma rab tu 'dra ba la dug dang tsha ba gsum dang ske tshe dang tsha ba'i mar khu dang khrag gis byugs la de'i sngags zlos pas dur khrod kyi me la gdungs na zhag bdun gyis mngon sum du ci 'dod pa ster ro/ /de nas bzod par gsol la mtshan ma gnas dbe+en par bzhag ste/ rdzas dang dbral bar bya'o/ /nan tur gyis sgrub pa'o/ /da ni mnyes par bya bas thabs gzhan bshad par bya'o/ /gser dngul lam zangs lcags kyi shog bu la pad+ma 'dab ma ① brgyad pa gnyis byas la/ gcig la snga ma lta bu'i lha dgu bya/ /gcig la lha mo dgu bri zhing de nas rab gnas byas la de gnyis kha sbyar bas mnyes par bsams la mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ras dril 5la za ma tog ser pos bkang ba'i dbus su stsal drote maṇ+ḍal khru brgyad pa/ gru bzhi pa byi dor legs par byas la me tog ser po bkram pa'i dbus su za ma tog cebazhag la dus gsum du mchod pa bya ba dang bstod pa dang / bskor ba dang bzlas pa byas na dngos grub chen po brgyad kyang ster na dngos grub phal pa lta ci smos/ nor rgyun ma ni gser mdog la g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rgyan ma lus pa dang ldan zhing rab tu mdzes pa'i na chung ma'o/ /zla 'od ma dang sbyin ma dang / /rab sbyin ma dang 'phags ma dang / /rab bzang ma dang sbas ma dang / /lha mo dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /rang rang gi grogs khyapo dang mdog dang lag cha 'dra ba'o/ /nor lha brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa phyag gnyis par 21—1009

yang rung ngo / /oṃ ba su jo ri ṣ+yo ①dha dz+wa me de hi swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kātre+e ②swā hā/oṃ de bye ④swā hā/ oṃ su bha dā yi rjoswā hā/ oṃ āt+yā ⑤yi swā hā/ oṃ su daṭ+wā yi buswā hā/ oṃ gubhā yi ⑦swā hā/ oṃ dat+ta yi dze+eswā hā/ oṃ sa ra swa h+ye swa ⑨hā/ sgrub pa na dha na me de hi zhes spel la bzlas so/ /rje btsun dze+e bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rje sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā ⑩ka ra bha dra dang / lo tsā ⑪ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /gnod sbyin thams cad dze+e bha la bzhin la/ gnod sbyin mo thams cad nor rgyun ma bzhin no zhes gsang ba'i dze+e bha la'i sgrub ⑫thabs las ⑫'byung ngo / /kha dog so so las zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pa thams cad la bī ④dza pū ra dang / g.yon thams cad no'u le'o zhes rgya che ba'i sgrub thabs las gsungs so// //bsdur mchan/1༷༷5 humatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉tsābatsun 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang gi sgrubs thabs slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'o// sri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wās rā/ ①〈〈snar 〉thastan/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṭha/ 1༷༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wa/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉marabar ba'i/ sne〈'ar 〉shesangs su/ du〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ma /⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7sa te/ ④〈〈pe 〉ratang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉skozhar 〉thaklag1 ༷7 kū〈〈snar 〉7ra/ ② 〈〈snar 〉〉zag ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉blo/ rjo〈sar 〉d+kusna/1༷༷8 1〈〈snar 〉thas/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7bzhin ni/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉wa dza pu/ bu〈sar 〉thastan/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'an+d+ra/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ye/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉༅/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mizad/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadi/1༷༷9 ①〈〈pe〉〉〈shar 〉7ma/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tsāl/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉thartsal/ dhi〈sar 〉ratog21—1010

(kye〈〈snar 〉〉grog1༷1༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha ri ṇi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ka:/ 〈〈snar 〉〉karje/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dha na dā ya/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byi/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ār+ya/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyi bha tre+e/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kub kyai/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉daḥ/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa ra swa ste/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉zhud+dha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉zhudha/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bi/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (691)21wa 1011

༄/ /gsang ba'i jo bha la'i sgrub thabs/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu h+ya 5dze+e bha la sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/gsang ba'i dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa dze+e bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la thog mar re zhig sngags pas gdong gi gtsang sbra la sogs pa byas nas/ skye bo med pa'i sa phyogs su bde ba'i stan la gnas te/ bdag gis rje btsun dze+e bha la mnyes par byas la sems can thams cad mchog gi bde ba la sbyar bar bya'o zhes byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdza gi yi ge ser po bltas te/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rje btsun dze+e bha la mdun du bsams la yang dag par mchod de phyag byas te/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas te/ 'jigs pas sdog byepa thams cad bshags par bya/ /dga' bas 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems ni rnam 21—1012

par gzung / /de'i rjes su byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā 1wa yis kopho2haṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis ①thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su smon lam gyi shugs kyis rgo khaṃ baṃ lo gi sa bon las skyes pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba la dze+e ser po las skyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das dze+e bha la bsgom par bya ste/ rgyan thams cad 'dzin pa gser gyi kha dog can/ lho ba 'phyang ba/ g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag dag gis sre mo ④/dang sa bon gang ba 'dzin pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi cod pan ⑤ut+pa la'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams su nor bu bzang po dang / gang ba bzang po dang / nor sbyin dang / rnam thos rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rna rgyan kor skeb rjodang / rol pa 'khyil pa dang / rtsen pa'i phreng ba dang / grong gi dbang phyug dang / de bzhin du spyod pa'i dbang phyug ste bshad pa'i rim pas der de ltar nor rgyun ma dang / zla mdzes ma dang / sbyin ma dang / legs sbyin ma dang / 'phags ma dang / legs bzangs ma dang / sbas ma dang / lha mo dang / dbyangs can ma ste/ gnod sbyin mo 'di dag rnams ⑦bsam par bya'o/ /nor rgyun ma dang dze+e bha la lhan cig tu'o/ /gnod sbyin ma thams cad nor rgyun ma bzhin no/ /gnod sbyin thams cad dze+e bha la bzhin no/ /'di ltar bsams te sngags bzlas par bya ste de la gnod sbyin rnams kyi ni/ oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ya dha rgo me de hi de hi swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ pūṇ+ḍi bha dā ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ḍa ba rja ya swā hā/ oṃ bi tsi kuṇ+ḍi ⑨li ne+e swā hā/ oṃ ki li mā ⑫li de shālhaswā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ya zheswā 21—1013

hā / oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swā hā/ de nas gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dha ri bye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kās+t+ya swā hā/ oṃ daṣ+ṭha ma ①swā hā/ oṃ su ②datre+e swā hā/oṃ āt+yā sdeyi swā hā/ oṃ su bha dā yi ④swā hā/ oṃ gubhā yi rjoswā hā/ oṃ de bye swā hā/oṃ sa ra swa tre+e tre7swā hā/ 'di lta bu thun gsum du bzlas pas chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad ster ba la 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ster ro/ /tho rangs bya rog mi grag par chu'i dbus su bzlas na nor 'dzad ⑦pa med cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gser la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la nor rgyun ma dang / gnod sbyin mo lhan cig pa dang / 'dab ma gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das rdza bha la la gnod sbyin gyis yongs su bskor ba bris nas mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ras sbyar te/ rab gnas legs par byas la mnyes par byas na grub pa chen po brgyad ster ro/ /zho dang bu ram dang bcas pa'i zan dang sha dang / chang spangs pa'i gtor ma bzlas pa'i sngags kyis rgyun du sbyin no/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i rdza bha la'i sgrub gluthabs rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po dza ya se na'i zhal snga nas dang / btsun pa dharma ⑨ yon tan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //21—1014

bsdur mchan/1༷12 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanasang ba'i rdza bha la'i sgrub thabs bsdo/gas so// 0yi〈〈pe 〉〉te/ hunye〈〈snar 〉〉gigs/1༷13 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉te/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wa3/ tshege〈〈pe 〉〉tre/〈〈snar 〉stade/ ④〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mong /⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ri can/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ste/ slebs/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉smon ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa kuṇ+ḍa/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi ya/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skaban+d+ra ye/1༷14 ①〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉darngu/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉pra/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉lko45/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gruṇ+ḍi bha t+ta/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gub rkye/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉padzad/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (692)21wa 1015

༄/ /rgya che ba'i jo bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ṭ+wā༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bista ra dze+e bha la sā dha ni37/ bod skad du/rgya che ba'i rdza bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ nor gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon bzhin du thams cad byas la/ stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes su cung zad dmar ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnod sbyin gyi shing lta bu'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa'o/ /de'i dbus su baṃ gyi 1sa bon las nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis klubs thupa mo/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba 'di lta ste/ zla 'bras/sbyin ma/ legs sbyin ma/ 'phags ma rnams ni phyogs kyi'o/ /legs bzangs thum/ sbas ma/ lha mo dang / dbyangs can ma rnams byumatshams kyi zer te 'di dag go/ /bzang mo dang / shin tu bzang mo dang / mdzes ma dang / sbas ma dang / shin tu sbas ma dang / dbyangs can ma dang /21—1016

'phags ma dang / zla mdzes ma'o/ /'di rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i lha mo chen mo de'i bha ga'i dbus su dze+e gi yi ge las skyes pa'i dze+e bha la nor rgyun ma la 'khyud cing kha sbyar ba las byang chub kyi sems rnam par 'thon pa las skyes pa'i rin po che'i tshogs kyi ①phyag rgya can rab tu gsal bar bsgom par bya ste/ 'dzag pa'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das kyi shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su nor bu bzang po sku mdog sngon po'o/ /lhor gang ba bzang po ser po/ nub tu nor sbyin dmar po/byang du rnam thos sras ser po/ me dang bden bral dang rlung dang dbang ldan gyi grwa rnams su rna rgyan kor ( /sleb sngon po/ rtsen pa'i phreng ba dmar po/ grong byegi dbang phyug ljang gu/ gser gyi mdog can kyi spyod pa'i dbang phyug ste/ zur phud lnga pa can g.yas pa'i phyag na sa bon bī dza ⑤pū ra gang ba dang / g.yon pa'i phyag na rin po che'i char 'be+ebs pa'i sre mo 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga 'phro ba/ de dag gis kyang rin po che'i char 'be+ebs par bsam/ zhabs kyi 'og nas dung gi ⑥'gro ba dang /pad+ma'i tshogs kyi gter dang / rin po che la sogs pa'i char khyim du zhabs kyis 'be+ebs ⑦par bsam par bya'o/ /dpal dze+e bha la mgon po mdog ser po at+pa la'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gnod sbyin brgyad po 'di rnams kyi yang yum gyi bha ga'i dbus nas rin po che'i char 'bebs par gyur pa dze+e bha la dang 'dra ba bsgom par bya'o/ /shar gyi sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po dgod/ lho sgor ⑤gnod spyin chen po dgod/ nub sgor rtsen pa dang rtsen pa chen po dgod/byang sgor gang ba dang shin tu gang ba dgod/ 'di rnams gcer bu 'bras bu 'phyang zhing lto ba 'phyang 1 ba rin po che'i char 'be+ebs pa rnams so/ /mgo bo la 21—1017

nor bu bzang po/ mig gnyis la rnam thos/ kha la grong gi dbang phyug go/ /nu ma'i bar du gang ba bzang po/ lte bar nor sbyin/ brla dag la rtsen pa'o/ /rna rgyan kor tshosleb dang spyod pa'i dbang phyug ⑤ gnyis ni rkang pa gnyis la ste 'di ni lha dgod pa'o/ /yi ge dgod pa ni gtso bo'i lus la sngags dgod par bya ste/spyi bor oṃ/ kha la rdza/ lag pa gnyis la bha la/ snying la dza/ lte bar len / brla gnyis la dru ya ༄ da/ ngar gdong gnyis la swā hā'o/ /gzhan yang yod de4/ spyi bor oṃ/ dpral bar dh+ri/ rna ba dag la hūṃkhye / mgo bo'i rgyab tu swā6/ mkhrig mar oṃ/ lag pa'i dbus su lcu/ sen mo'i rtse mo thams cad la rjartse/ sor mo'i rtsa ba thams cad du 3swā hā/ oṃ lja rja swā hā / zhes bya ba'i chu'i sngags so/ /de bzhin du mdzub mo la nor bu bzang po/gung mo la gang ba bzang po/ srin lag la nor sbyin/ mthe'u chung la rnam sras / lag pa'i logs su grong gi dbang phyug /rna rgyan kor ⑨sleb ni mthe bo la'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang mthe bo'i bar du spyod pa'i dbang phyug /lag pa'i dbus su dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra'o/ /yi ge 'di rnams dngos su lha yin te lag pa la dgod par byas nas rdo rje'i chu la sogs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga yis sbyin par bya'o/ /lnga po med na yang de dang bsres pa'am/ yang na rdo rje'i chu dang bsres pa khyor ba gang 'thungs nas lag pa khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad thun bzhir byin na lha yun mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gser dngul la sogs pa yang dag par 'phel zhing sa gzhi rdzas kyis gang bar byed do/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ rja bye saṃḥzhes bya ba brjod pas chu'i khyor ba rnam par sbyin par bya'o/ /de ltar byas kyang gal te ma grub na de'i tshe dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi gzugs su bdag nyid bsgoms te rdza bha la'i sku 21—1018

dug dang ske tshe dang lan tshwa dang da du ra'i lo ma'i khu ba dang dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs nas dus gsum du bsro zhing bskam 1par bya'o/ /phyis dur khrod kyi me la gdung bar bya ste khros pas nges par 'grub po/ /rgya che ba'i dze+e bha la'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //chu sbyin dbang po'i sgrub ②thabs 'di gsum dbang ma thob pa la sbyin du mi btub 1po// //bsdur mchan/1༷16 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉pho che ba'i dze+e bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// zhu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / zhu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉(go/ ④/〈〈snar 〉thaklubs/e 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazang / pya 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ras/1༷17 ① pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kus/ sgo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉༅ko/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉radong / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉la/⑪ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rgas/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉thabe+eb/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7gnod sbyin dang / ⑨〈〈snar 〉thachang /1༷18 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ko/ zhu〈〈snar 〉〉phyugs/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du ye/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7de/ 3〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi rlu/ rngu 〈〈snar 〉rnam/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉tsa rlu/ sno〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 swā hā'o/ /oṃ dze+e bha la dza len+d+ra ye/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉d+ku/1༷19 ① 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ma ma/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatub/21byed1019

༄7/ /bgegs rnams ma lus skrag mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje hūṃ mdzad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ /stang stabs rim pa bshad par bya/ /g.yon brkyang dpe dang mthun pa'i stabs/ /sa ga'i 'dug stangs g.yas brkyang dang / /zlum por gnas dang rkang pa gcig /rus sbal rkang stabs bdun 1par bshad/ /gang yang gshol dbyibs lta bur ni/ /g.yon pa'i brla dang pus mo gnyis/ /g.yas pa'i byen pa brlar bcar te/ /thad kar 'jog par byed pa dang / /rgyar ni rkang mthil lngar bcas pa/ /g.yon brkyang ba ①ni rab tu grags/ /rkang mtheb ④dang ni rting pa dang / /mnyam por shin tu bcer ba ni/ /bstan pa mthun pa'i rkang stabs su/ /de nyid shes pa rnams kyis bshad/ /rkang pa'i sor mo phyir bstan cing / /pus mo'i lha nga gnyis brkyang ste/ /rgyar ni nyi shu rtsa drug sor/ /sa ga'i 'dug 21—1021

stangs yin par brjod/ /g.yon las yongs su bzlog pa ni/ /g.yas brkyang par ni shes par bya/ /gang du pus mo gnyis 'jog pa'i/ /gnas su lag gnyis 'jog pa ni/ /ngang pa'i gshog pa ltar byas pa/ /zlum po'i 'dug stangs yin par 'dod/ /g.yas pa'i brlar ni g.yon pa gzugs/ /de ni rkang pa gcig ces bya/ /g.yas pas g.yon pa'i sor mo mnan/ /rus sbal rkang stabs yin par bshad/ /dang po bcu yin gnyis pa lnga/ /gsum pa drug ste bzhi pa dgu/ /lnga pa de bzhin drug pa gnyis/ /bdun pa la ni gcig dang sbyar / /de dag kyang gang zhe na/ seng ge'i stang stabs dang / seng ge'i glal ba dang / rdo rje sgrog dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / bud med kyi sgyu 'phrul dang / rdo rje dral ba dang / rdo rje mche ba dang / ral gri'i thabs dang /be+egs kyu'i thabs dang / mdung thung gi thabs dang / thag mdung 'phen thabs dang / rdo rje'i stang stabs dang / rdo rje gsor ba dang / rdo rje ro langs dang / gtun shing gi thabs dang / ba dan gyi thabs dang / rdo rje 'gugs byed dang / rdo rje 'jo tshul dang / mi 'jigs pa'i tshul dang /'bras bu'i thabs dang / mchog sbyin pa'i thabs dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / rdo rje 'phen pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba dang / rdo rje stobs po ches 'degs pa dang / rdo rje gad mo dang / rdo rje'i thabs dang /zhags pa'i thabs dang / be+e con gyi thabs dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa'i thabs dang / mdung bu'i thabs dang / rdo rje'i gar dang / sgo bzhi byin gyis brlabs tsapa dang / rdo rje gdu ②bu dang / rdo rje 'khyil pa dang / rdo rje'i sgra dang / 'khor lo'i thabs dang / pad+ma'i tshul dang / gzhu'i thabs dang /21—1022

mda' gzung ba'i thabs dang / mda' 'phang ba'i thabs dang / rkang pa ya gcig gi stang stabs dang / bung ba'i 'phur stangs ①dang / rdo rje 'degs pa la ②sogs pa de dag go/ /de dag gi thabs bshad par bya ste/ rang nyid kha 'og tu bltas te gdangs la lag pa gnyis kyi mkhrig ma mdud de kha'i drung du bzhag pa ni seng ge'i stang stabs so/ /de nyid las thams cad du blta ④bas lce 'gul ba dang bcas pa ni seng ge'i glal ba'o/ /rdo rje sgog ni rang gi snying gar rdo rje bcing bar ④byed pa ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bsdams la/ /mdzub khyemo bkug ste bcings nas su/ /bskor ba'i tshul du bya ba ni/ /lha rnams dgug pa'i dam pa'o/ /zhes bshad pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis phur bu bzung ste bgegs kyi steng du bzhag la / /g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje tho ba bzung nas brdung ba ni rdo rje tho ba'o/ /gar dang bcas pa'i rdo rje sgeg mo'i phyag rgya bcings la/ mgo bo g.yon du cung zad 'dud par byas bye pa ni bud med kyi sgyu 'phrul lo/ /snying gar rdo rje bsdams mepa 'byed pa ni rdo rje dral ba'o—/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u phyachung gnyis bsgreng ste bzlog la kha'i 'gram du mche ba'i tshul du bzhag pa ni rdo rje mche ba'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi shubs nas drangs te g.yas pa'i khu tshur kyis ⑨ dpung mgor ral gri 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhag pa ni ral gri'i thabs so/ /g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dang g.yas pa'i mthe'u ḍa chung mdud par byas te g.yas pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas pas 'gugs pa ni lcags kyu'i thabs so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis g.yon du 'debs pa ltar byed pa ni mdung thung gi thabs so/ /lag pa g.yon dkur brten pa la g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis thag mdung bskor ⑩ba'i tshul du lan gsum du bskor nas 'phen 21—1023

pa ni thag mdung 'phen pa'i thabs so/ /rdo rje bsnun pa'i tshul ni rdo rje'i stang stabs so/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje 'og tu lan gsum gsor la①/ de bzhin du steng du yang lan gsum gsor bar ④byed pa ni rdo rje gsor ba'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis ro la bzung nas zhuza ba'i tshul du byed cing yongs su blta 4 ba ni rdo rje ro langs so/ /rdo rje bsdams pas bzung ba'i gtun shing gis bgegs rnams rdung thub ltar byed pa ni gtun shing gi duthabs so/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bstan par byas la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo brkyang ba'i tshigs dang bor mdzub mo bkug nas dpung mgor bzhag pa ni ba dan kyi thabs so / /g.yon pa dkur brten la g.yas pas snying ga nas 'gugs pa'i tshul du byed pa'i snying ga de nyid du rdo rje sems dpa' ltar 'jog pa ni rdo rje 'gugs byed do/ /snying ga'i mdun du 'gying bag dang bcas pas lag pa ④yongs su bskor ba ni rdo rje 'jo tshul lo/ /g.yon pa dkur brten la g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i tshul du byed pa ni mi 'jigs pa'i tshul lo/ /g.yon pa de nyid du bzhag pa la g.yas pa'i lag mthil du 'bras bu bzhag pa'i tshul du byas te mdun du drang ba ltar byed pa ni 'bras bu'i thabs so/ /de nyid las g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa'i tshul du byed pa ni mchog sbyin pa'i thabs so/ /thal mo sbyar ba bstod bye pa'i tshul du snying gar bzhag pa ni phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul lo/ /g.yon pa dkur brten la g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'phen pa'i tshul du byed pa ni rdo rje 'phen pa'o/ /kha'i steng rngu'og tu lag pa gnyis bkan te de nyid dang 'jigs su rung ba ltar byed pa ni rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /snying gar lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje rtse gsum ltar byas la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur dbyig ⑩pa ltar 'debs pas rtse 21—1024

gsum par byas te 'jog pa ni rdo rje stobs po ches 'degs pa'o①/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bkan te khar tso7bzhag la ha ha zhes dgod pa'i tshul gyis yi ge ha ha ④bzhi brjod pa ni rdo rje gad mo'o/ /g.yon pa khro bo'i khu tshur las mdzub mo snying gar bsgrengs ④la g.yas pa ba dan gsum par byas pas rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul du byed pa ni rdo rje'i thabs so/ /mkhrig ma gnyis mdud ⑤pa ni zhags pa'i thabs so/ /g.yon pa dkur brten la g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis mthe bo pya nang nas bton te bsgreng ba ni be+e con gyi thabs so/ /de nyid las lag pa g.yas pas mdung rtse gcig pa 'phen pa'i tshul du byed pa ni rtse gabyug pa'i thabs so /de nyid las mdung bu 'debs shing bgegs gsod pa'i tshul du byed pa ni rdo rje ④mdung bu'i thabs so/ /lag pa g.yon brkyang ba dude'i rtsa bar g.yas pa'i mtheb ⑨chung nas bkrol te ba dan gsum par byas pa ni rdo rje'i gar ro/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su sa gnon la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas stong pa nyid la sogs pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi bsgom pa ni sgo bzhi byin gyis ⑩brlab pa'o//g.yon pa dkur brten nas g.yas pa'i ⑪sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba ni rdo rje 'khyel pa'o—/ /g.yas pa rdo rje snying gar 'jog cing g.yon pas rna ba'i drung du dril bu dkrol ba ni rdo rje'i sgra'o/ /snying gar rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u ⑫chung dang mdzub mo rdo rje mdud pa byas te 'khor lo ltar bskor ba ni 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o/ /snying gar pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul du byed pa ni pad+ma'i tshul lo/ /g.yon pa gzhu 'dzin pa'i tshul du 'jog pa ni gzhu'i thabs so/ /de nyid mda' dang bcas par rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa ni mda' gzung ba'i thabs so/ /de nyid mda' 'phen pa ltar byed pa ni mda' 'phen pa'i tshul lo/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i brla la 21—1025

g.yas pa'i mthil btsugs te/ lag pa gnyis dkur brten pa ni rkang pa ya gcig gi stang stabs so/ /de nyid dang g.yas g.yon du lag pa gnyis bskor ba ni bung ba'i 'phur stangs so/ /g.yon pa ①dkur brten la g.yas pa snying gar rdo rje gtad de 'jog pa ni rdo rje 'degs ⑤pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon blo gos ldan pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa yi dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /'dug stangs rnams kyi go rims dbye ba dag /de ni ci nus kyis ni rnam par sbyar/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung dang ni pad+ma'i ④'dug stangs dang / /sems dpa'i skyil krung dang ni dpa' bo'i thu'adug stangs dang / /bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang ni de bzhin tsog pur 'dug /rol pa'i gnas thabs 'dug stangs bdun par bshad / /g.yas pa'i byin pa dang ni brla dbus su/ /rkang pa g.yon pa rnam par bzhag nas kyang / /de yi steng du g.yas pa bzhag pa ni/ /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung zhes bya bar bshad/ /g.yas pa'i byin pas byin pa g.yon mnan la/ /pus mo gnyis ka dbab par byas nas ni/ /lus ni rab tu zhi ba'i tshul dang ldan//pad+ma'i 'dug stangs yin par mkhas pas bshad/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i brla yi steng du ni/ /rkang pa g.yas pa cung zad tsam sbyar la/ /g.yon pa de yi 'og tu bzhag pa ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung zhes rnam par grags/ /rkang pa g.yon pa yis ni skyil mo krung / /phyed du bcas la de dang nye bar yang / /rkang pa g.yas pa drang por bzhag pa ni/ /de ni dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs yin par 'dod/ /rkang pa gnyis ka stan gyi steng du ni/ /drang pya po nyid du thur du brkyang byas la/ /de nyid brtan por rab tu 'jog pa ni/ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs yin par rab tu grags/ /rkang pa gnyis ka mtho gang tsam gyis ni/ /27—1026

bar du chod par stan la bzhag nas kyang / /tsog tsog por ni 'dug pa gang yin pa/ /de nyid tsog pu'i 'dug stangs nyid du bshad/ /rkang pa g.yas pa nyid ni sems dpa' yi/ /skyil krung phyed pa brtan par rab byas la/ /g.yon pa sgeg dang bcas pas brkyang sheb ni/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs su ni grags pa yin—/ /rdo rje'i pyaskyil krung nyid la gnas nas ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs phyag rgya bcing / /pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis kyang gesgeg mo la/ /sogs pa rnams kyi rgyaphyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung la gnas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs phyag rgya bcing / /dpa' bo'i rgya'adug stangs nyid la gnas nas kyang / /rdo rje khro bo'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis kyang bya ba ni/ /byams pa la sogs rnams kyi skyephyag rgya basbung / /tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyis ni pho nya dang / /bran pho bran mo la sogs phyag rgya bcing / /rol pa'i gnas thabs kyis ni bya ba gang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /de ltar rnam par bsdus pa las byung ba'i/ /dge ba gang yin des ni 'gro ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mgon dang bcas pa der/ /gzhol ba nyid du rtag tu 'bab par shog/⑦stang stabs kyi bkod pa slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs 5kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //21—1027
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (694)

༄ / /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā rte/dza maṇ+ḍa la bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya sogs sgrib las nges grol/ /me long ye shes la sogs ldan/ /'jam dpal gsang ba'i 'khor lo mchog /btud de bdag dran phyir de bshad/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i gzhung dam pa/ /'khor lo'i man ngag rim pa 'dis/ /chu thog rjes gnang tha ma yis/ /gang zhig dbang bskur de nas blang / /gsang ba'i 'khor 'dir de nyid thob/ /gsang dang shes rab dbang bskur bas/ /gsang shes rnal 'byor de nyid shes/ /theg gsum dgongs pa'i de nyid shes/ /rigs ༄ —dang snying po sngags phyag rgya/ /ting nge 'dzin ni gsum dag dang / /thun mong cig shos dngos grub dang / /rgyud gzhung gi ni rnam dbye shes/ /21—1030

dam tshig ldan zhing sdom la ⑨gnas/ /shes rab rnal 'byor la rab brtson/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba mkhas/ /sems can don sgrub 'os pa yin/ /gtong brtan la sogs ldan gyur kyang / /sngar bshad yon tan mi ldan na/ /'di ni 'gro don 'os min te/ /de yi yon tan 'di mchog yin/ /brtser ldan brtul zhugs bzang blos kyeldan/ /dad ldan zab mo de nyid shes/ /rang gi 'khor gnas sngon bsnyen rngupa/ /byas nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /yid dang rjes mthun gnas la lar/ /tsan+dan mchog la sogs pas byug /me tog dri bzang gcal ④bkram par/ /nang par dang por 'dug nas ni/ /rnam thar sgo ni legs dag phyir/ /snying gar rma ni 'od 'bar ba bsams nas dge ba mngon 'phel phyir/ /bshags la sogs pa rab tu bya/ /phyogs bcur dus gsum byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdun gnas te/ /snying po'i 'od byung gzugs la sogs/ /mchod pa cho ga bzhin du bya/ /rang gi log rtog ⑤tsam las byung / /nyes byas dus gsum byas pa rnams/ /rmi lam rmi lam sogs bzhin kun/ /lan gsum dag ni 'chags par bgyid/ /sgogs sangs sras mchog 'phags rnams dang / /gzhan gyi dge ba dam pa gang //ma lus la bdag yi rang zhing / /rdzogs byang chub tu rjes bsngo bgyi/ /kun 'dod dbugs 'byin sprul mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun la bdag bskul ba/ /bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa/ /'jig rten kun spyig med snang mdzod/ /kun rtog ma lus dag gyur cing —sna / /rang rig dga' ba thugs chud la/ /rang gzhan don gyi 'bras bu sprul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ /sems mchog dam chos ma lus pa/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dam 21—1031

pa'i phun tshogs gnas bsam yas/ /bdag ni yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /mi ldog dbugs 'byin 'thob gyur cing / /rgyu mthun la sogs 'bras bur ldan/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur las byung nyid/ /tshogs la'ang bdag nyid skyabs su mchi / /thub dbang sras kyi lam gyi mchog /spyod pa thog mtha' med rtogs byed / /kun sangs rgyas bdag blo mchog gis/ /de bas da ni gnas par bgyi / /sgrib pa thams cad yang dag sel 2/ /ye shes mtha' yas bdud rtsi'i gnas / /'khrul pa'i lta ba rab rtogs phyir/ /rnam kun byang chub sems bskyed do/ /byang chub sems dang sangs rgyas nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur ma chags nyid/ /so so rang rig chos yin phyir/ /stong pa'i ye shes bdag can bdag /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kopho skyehaṃ/ hūṃ mdzad yang na gtsug tor ram/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs nyid/ /khro bo'i 'khor lor gnas srung phyir/ /bsams la bgegs ni rab tu gzhom zhu/ /de nas chos kyi dbyings bsams te/ /zur gsum dkar zhing gyen dkar gnas/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor sna tshogs 'od/ /mkha' nang 'og pad rdo rje gnas/ /der rgyu zi'akhor lo las byung ba'i/ /rig bcas rnam snang las byung ba/ /sangs rgyas spros tshogs mkha' khyab pa/ /zur bzhi la sogs yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma lha yi gdan/ /zla ba nyi mas legs mnan pa/ /rin chen dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /gzhal yas khang pa rab bsam bya/ /dbyangs yig mtshan dang yang dag ldan/ /ka sogs dpe byad 'od zer can/ /dbus ma'i zla ba'i sa gdan la sems/ /ye shes zla ba rnam bsgoms deng ④/ /dang po'i snying las byung rdo rje/ /dmar zhing dang po'i snying por ldan/ /sprul pas 'gro 21—1032

ba'i don byas nas/ /bdag nyid de yi nga rgyal ldan/ /sku dang zhal mchog shel lkuzla 'dra/ /g.yas pa sngo kyel cig shos dmar/ /rnam pa kun mchog rgya che zhing / /yon tan na bza' rgyan gyemachog ldan/ /rdo rje skyil krung legs par bzhugs—/ /phyag gnyis shes rab mchog la 'khyud/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri ste/ /g.yon na rin chen pad+mar ldan/ /dpal ldan shes rab thabs bdag nyid / /'gro ba'i phun tshogs rnams kyi gnas/ /kun du bzang po 'od 'phro bar—/ /bdag nyid rnam par bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dod chags ches 'dul ba'i/ /snod kyi ④'jig rten mthong ba dang / /dga' ba'i sgra yis rang nang du/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams gzhug phyopar bya/ /der ni spyan sogs rigs lngamachog dang / /gzugs sogs yul gyi bdag nyid kyi/ /lha mo dgu ru phyung nas ni/ /rang gi rig pa'i nang du gzhug /rang rig pad+ma'i lte ba ru/ /rab dga' las byung dkyil 'khor ni/ /sprul nas 'dir ni 'gro ba kun—/ /dbugs dbyung ⑦phyir ni gzhug par bya/ /mkha' khyab sangs rgyas bshes gnyen mchog /rang rdo rje nang zhu las byung / /mi ldog phyir dang de nyid kyi/ /ye shes 'bras thob rnguphyir dbang bskur/ /dbugs phyir ⑪'go ba de mthong nas/ /de yi dngos dbyung sa bon gyis/ /sems can thams cad phyung nas ni/ /'gro ba sems bdag dngos las byung / /sa yi snying po la sogs drug /mig sogs rang gi ngo bor byung / /k+ṣiṃ dz+rī ṅkukhaṃ shaṃ sko gzhan yang / /saṃ ni rim bzhin sa bon yin/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs drug /phyi nang bdag nyid ngo bor byung / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ 'di dang / / rim gyis ⑪sa bon phyi rol gnas/ /spyan la sogs pa'i rig lku pa de/ /sa la sogs pa'i ngo bor byung / /21—1033

lo rmā paṃ t+t+waṃ 'di dag gis/ /'gro chos bdag nyid de nyid skyes/ /rtag pa la sogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gzugs sogs phung po'i ngo bor byung / / rgyu s+t+waṃ dz+rī gyokhaṃ hūṃ rnams kyis/ /chos rnams thams cad yang dag dbyung / /de nas oṃ āḥX snye/hūṃ zhes bya'i/ /sems ni 'od ldan hoḥsnyeganyis spel/ /gsang ba'i chu skyes khong nang gnas/ /rgyu mthun chung ngu dag phyir ro/ /'dod chags me de 'bar ba yis/ /sku gnyis dag ni zhu bar byas/ /bshes mchog ltar snang phyogs lha mo//glu yi gsol bas legs par bskul/ /sems can khams na gnas kyi 5dbang phyug khyod ni 5rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba byu yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab 7/tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i phyasku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan//sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog don rab tu phan par gzigs/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i ⑨gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi ⑩dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /spyod pa dri med kun du bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i 11'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid gzigs/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /slong bar byed pa'i dor byas pas/ /zhu ba 21—1034

rgud pa ltar mthong ste/ /dngos rnams sgyu ma ltar rig nas/ /rang sngags don du slar yang gyur/ /zhal mchog gur kum lta bu ste/ /g.yas pa sngo la cig shos dkar—/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gzhon nu 'dra/ /shes rab dga' bas cig car mdzes/ /rang hūṃbhesnang shes rab ldan gyur cing / /phyag gnyis shes rab dam pa 'khyud/ /ral gri 'od ldan mda' yi mchog /ut+pal sngon gzhu phyag na bsnams/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi sprul 'phro bas/ /'gro ba gsum gyi don sdogs pa/ /rang gi sa bon mtshan las byung / /'jam pa'i rdo rje rang nyid 'gyur sa7—/ /srid par chags pas mtha' yas shing / /zhi bar chags na 'byor nyams 'gyur/ /sgyu mas bsnyen pa yang dag byas/ /chos dbyings bdag nyid can du 'gyur/ /oṃ dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha1haṃ/ bshes gnyen dam pas rgyu mthun byas/ /smin las thams cad mkhyen nyid 'gyur/ /de ni mig sogs byin brlab pa/ /nye bar bsgrub pa yin par 'dod/ /sa snying rdo rje can mkha' snying / /'jig dbang sgrib sel kun du bzang / /de ni sa bon rnams kyis ni/ /mig la sogs pa yang dag dgang / /skyes bu bskyed pa chos longs spyod—/ /sprul pa las byung 'gro don nyid/ /thugs kyi gsang sogs byen gyis brlab—/ /de bas sgrub pa'i don du 'gyur/ /rang nyid gog ma spyi bo'i zlar/ /hūṃ āḥ.oṃ las byung ba'i gtso/ /rdo rje chu skyes 'khor lo yi/ /dbus gnas thugs sogs gsang ba bsgom/ /de thugs shes rab yan lag 'dus/ /'od kyi gzugs ni rdo rje sogs/ /'od kyis phyogs dus kun mchod cing / /ma lus gtso la khyab par gyur/ /gang zhig snying skog spyi bor zhugs/ /de yi mdzad don rdzogs par byas/ /de ni thugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /byin brlabs ce21—1035

de ni rab tu bsgrub/ /dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas hūṃsu/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin kyis brlabs nas rngu su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ātā kolha1/haṃ / chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ④su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur gzhugs thu/pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms nas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas pyasu/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāg 7badz+ra swa bhā ⑧ba āt+ma kopho/—haṃ/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas rmyesu/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ⑪su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kopho ⑩haṃ/rjes nyurnyadran bcu drug dag pas ni/ /byed pa yin zhes nges gsungs pas/ /de ni thugs sogs byin brlab rngupa'i/ /gnas skabs min phyir ma bshad do/ /sgyu ma'i shes rab yang dag 'dus/ /gsang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid blta/ /dbang 'bras chung ngu rnam dag phyir/ /sgrub pa chen po yin par 'dod/ /ye shes sems thugs snying 'od kyi/ /phyogs bcu'i mgon po yang dag bskul/ /de 'od las byung rig pa rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i bla chus bkang bum bsnams pas/ /21—1036

gtso bo dpal ldan rang dbang bskur/ /rigs dbang cod pan dam pa yin/ /de bzhin rgyu mthun sogs bar mas/ /rang rig shes rab rnam par sbyong thu / /spyi bo snying ga lte ba gsang / /rkang mthar thug pa'i cha re la/ /oṃ hūṃ swā 66 ༄kyehā snying po/ /rtags sogs rigs kyi bdag nyid can/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas lngas dgang bar bya/ /hūṃ a chu skyes 'dab brgyad pa/ /yang dag sbyangs des sangs rgyas rnams/ /hūṃ gi rdo rje mchog mnyes bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolhahaṃ④/ snying zla'i ral gri snying po'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab pa/ /bdag nyid la bzhugs sems mchog gi/ /gzugs su rdo rje'i pad legs gnas/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lo sa bon gyis/ /der bskyed nas ni brtan byas la/ /'gro ba'i mi shes dag bya'i phyir/ /rang gi cho gas dbyung bar bya/ /zhe sdang chen po'i don mdzad 5rgyal/ /bdag po mi bskyod yang dag bskul/ /badz+ra z-ika ces bya bas dbyung / /nor bu in+d+ra m+bi la'i mdog /g.yas pa dkar la cig shos dmar/ /dpal mchog dang po'i phyag dang ldan/ /dpal ldan legs bsdus bdag nyid kyi/ /dngos po kun gyis gzhug par bya/ /dzi na dzig gis dang po 'dra/ /gti mug chen pos don mdzad gtso/ /'khor lo bzang sogs dpal de bzhin/ /shar gyi zla dkyil dag la bsgom/ /rat+na dh+rika 5gis rin chen dbang / /gser mdog mnyam nyid brtson 'grus can/ /mgon po rin chen mchog sogs bsnams/ /gzhon nu'i zhal 'dra lho phyogs su'o/ /ā ro dzaka bye 7gis gsung dbang po/ /'dod chags chen pos don mdzad gtso/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog pad sogs/ /gzhon nu'i zhal 'dra nub phyogs su'o/ /pradz+nyā j-ika thu gis don yod dbang / /gtum 21—1037

chen phrag dog don mdzad pa/ /bai ḍūr+ya snang gzhon nu'i zhal/ /ral gri sogs bsnams byang du bsam/ /kun kyang ral pa cod pan bcas/ /rang rig gnyis su med par spyor/ /rgyan dang na bza' mchog kun ldan/ /pad+ma nyi dkyil dag la bsam/ /mo ha ra tīs 43shar lho ru/ /snying rje thabs kyis 'go don stsol/ /rang gi ngo bo sku dbang 'dra/ /spyan ni zla dkyil dag la bsam—/ /dz+wa ṣa ra tīs tsalho nub tu/ /byams dang smon lam 'dod sprul ba/ /dga' ༄ ldan thugs kyi dbang po 'dra/ /mā ma shī ni zla dkyil bsam/ /rā ga ra ṭīs 4nub byang du/ /dga' dang stobs dang ting 'dzin sprul/ /gsung gi dbang 'dra don dag bsam/ /gos dkar mo ni zla dkyil bsam/ /badz+ra ra tīs 3byang shar du/ /btang snyoms ye shes ting 'dzin stsol/ /rang gi ngo bor rin dbang 'dra/ /yid 'ong sgol ma zla dkyil bsam/ /'di rnams mtshan ma rim bzhin du/ /'khor lo ut+pal dmar po mchog /pad+ma ut+pal ser po ste/ /lhag ma rang bdag lta bur bstan/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi dang / /shar sgo yi ni ngos gnyis su/ /de nyid gsum gyi gzugs sogs pa/ /me long sogs bsnams sku sogs 'dra/ /ya mān+ta kṛta kyis yams 'joms/ /phung po zhes bya rnam 'jig pa/ /thugs kyi dbang 'dra lta rab 'bar/ /shar sgor khro bo'i skyil 6mos gnas/ /pradz+nyān+ta kṛta kyis srid 'joms/ /nyon mongs bdag lta 'jig byed pa/ /gtum zhing 'jigs la kun dang pya 'dra/ /gzhan gyis mi thub lho sgor ro/ /pad+mān+ta 5kṛta kyis 'dod 'joms/ /'chi bdag skyes pa'i tshogs 'jig pa/ /gtum zhing sgra zab gsung 1dbang 'dra/ /rta mgrin nub kyi sgo ru bsam/ /bispyornya kṛta kyis bgegs 'joms/ /bya ba lha yi bdud 21—1038

dag nyid/ /gtum la mi bskyod mdog 'dra ba/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa byang sgor bsam—/ /smin 'degs dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /sma ra smin ma spyan dmar ser—/ /zhal gdangs huljags ni rnam par bskyod/ /mche bar bcas shing rtag tu bzhad/ /'di rnams phyag na tho ba drag /dbyig 3pa pad+ma rdo rje thogs / /khros pa'i sbrul gyis sku la brgyan/ /rang rig shes rab yan lag lus—/ /rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo la bltas nas/ /kun nas rang gi dngos po yis—/ /snying po'i sa bon 'od lcags kyus/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo 'dra ba bsdu—/ /mthong bar gyur nas bgegs rnams ni/ /kun du bskrad de mngon par bsrung / /zla sogs me tog ldan pa yi/ /gsang sngags mchog bzlas mchod yon dbul/ /'khor lo de 'khor lo la gzhug/④ /mig dang sku sogs byin gyis brlab/ /sngon bzhin dbang bskur de la bsam/ /rgyu mthun la sogs chen po nyid/ /sangs rgyas cod pan mi bskyod pa/ /lhag ma rang bdag dbang bskur ba/ /sku dbang mi bskyod gsung dbang 5po/ /thugs dbang sgo ba rnams la 'dod/ /de ltar dbang bskur rang snying po'oke / /'od kyis shes rab pad der gzhug /gzugs sogs sru khung las byung ba'i/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs 'od ni/ /gzhal yas khang 'od las 'das nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ni rab khyab pas/ /thub dbang rang ni legs mchod pa'i/ /mchod dang mchod pa'i bdag can gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophoskyehaṃ—/ chos rnams kun kyi 'khor lo bstod/ /rang gi bdag nyid rdzogs sangs skus/ /ye shes lnga dang phyag rgya dang / /rigs brgya lnga dang gsum gyis so—/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' kyechen po/ /21—1039

dkyil mchog gsum pa yi ge gsum/ /rdo rje dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med—/ /rdo rje'i sgu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi 'chi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad sdogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba nyi ma chu dang sman/ /dri ni rlung ma'i lku'akhor lor gnas/ /oṃ gyis byin brlabs 'od bcas pa/ /de nyid gsum gyis mngon par bzlas/ /rdo rje'i lce mchog hūṃ bkod pa/ /bsams nas ye shes bdud rtsi blang / /snying ga'i zlar chud ma lus pa'i/ /'khor lo des ni tshim par bya/ /snying po'i 'od kyis sprul mgon pos/ /rang gi log rtog rnam spangs te/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas bdag nyid byas/ /snying po'i sa bon nang du gzhug /snying gar mtshan ma'i lte nang gnas/ /zla snying thig le'i gzugs can du/ /rang yid 'od ldan bsgoms nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' rab tu bsgom—/ /thugs gsung sku yi rdo rje yang / /'od kyi phreng bas rab sad bya/ /de ni snying gar zhugs bsam pa/ /rang gi ye shes bdud rtsi 'bab/ /de nas nang gi lus thams cad/ /ba spu las byung 'od zer tshogs/ /de yis kun nas snang byas la/ /'gro ba'i don ni rab rdzogs bya/ /yang na rang rtags phra bsgom pa/ /rig pa'i sna yi rtse mor gnas/ /thub rjopa'i 'khor lo rang rig pa//21—1040

shes rab dam pa 'dus 'od ldan/ /brtan pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang / /der rtogs 'od zer spro bya zhing / /sna tshogs mtshan ma sangs rgyas ni/ /yang dang yang du spro bar bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mchog /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer can/ /spros te sngags ni bzla ①bya ba/ /cig car yang na rim gyis so/ /rdo rje gsal chos 'khor lo ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer gtogs/ /gnas su de ni brtan byas la/ /ye shes sku ni spro zhing bzla/ /brjod cing srog gis spro bya zhing / /sngags ni rtsol bas bsdu bar bya/ /sku sogs spro dang bsdus pa yis//rim rjobazhin rim ④bzhin bzlas brjod bya/ /de ltar brjod de mkha' khyab pa'i//sku la sogs te rang 'od kyis/ / sngon bzhin ④ sna tshogs mchod mchog 'os/ /srog las rig pa'i tshogs rnams spro/ /rig pa sgeg shepas yongs 'khyud pa'i/ /bde ba babs pas dbang byas pa'i rjo/ /rtsol bas ye shes sangs rgyas tshogs/ /mthar ni rang gi nang la gzhug /thig le phra mo gsang gsum dbyung / /lhag mar mos pa rgyu mthun sogs/ /chung ngu la sogs kyis phye ltar/ /rnal 'byor bsnyen sogs de bzhin bsgom/ /rang snying de nyid mchog brtags pas/ /sems kyi 'jug pa zhum gyur na/ /spyan sogs tshogs kyi glu yis ni/ /'khor lo gsol btab ⑦mchod par bya/ /spyi bor zla ba oṃ rlan can/ /dam pa'i sems kyi ④chu 'dzag pas/ /sku gsung thugs ni tshim byed pa/ /cho ga bzhin du dbab par bya/ /de ltar ngal bso spu bzlas byas shing / /mkhas pas mchod la sogs byas nas/ /de ⑩nyid gsum bsnyus sangs rgyas rnams/ /bzhud pa'i skabs su gshegs su gsol/ /'di ni de nyid mthong bar bshad/ /'gro ba ma lus bltas nas kyang / /snying rjes ⑫de la phan pa'i phyir/ /smon lam rnams ni 21—1041

mngon du bya/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas kyang / /bdag po'i nga rgyal mngon du bya/ /'jug par rtogs tshe ṭurdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yul gyis ②yang dag mchod par bya/ /'jam dpal rdo rje kun bdag nyid/ /ngo bo nyid kyis yul rjes 'gro/ /de ltar yul rnams bsgom pa ni/ /rang rang dag par rnam par gnas/ /rtag pa la sogs ngo bo de/ /rang rig chos su yang dag gnas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang 'dra bar/ /dag pa'i sems dpar yang dag ldan/ /rang gi log rtog rnam spangs pas/ /bya ba thams cad rdzogs par bya/ /rtag tu tshad med rab sbyor bas/ /'khor lo mchog 'di mtha' yas mchod/ /rang snying zla bar rang 'khor gtso/ /rang gi sa bon rang zas la/ /legs dmigs rang snying de nyid kyis/ /bdud rtsis sangs rgyas kun tshim bya/ /chos nyid kun gyis dag pa dang / /de nyid gsum gyis mngon bzlas la/ /rang gi lha yi 'khor lo mchog /tshim bya des ni mchod par bya/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg dge tshul gyi / /sems tsam gyis ni yid kyis bya/ /ye shes me yis ④ phung po'i shing //bsregs 5pas 'di ni bla med yin/ /de ltar 'dod pa ma lus pas/ /bdag nyid rang lha'i dngos gyur dang / /gzhan yang de mchod bya ba yin/ /dam tshig bde gshegs bzhed pa yin/ /lus sogs las gang de dang des/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang / /rjes mthun 'gro ba'i bya ba rnams/ /rtag tu mnyam par gzhag gye pas bya/ /lus ngag las kyi rang bzhin gang / /phyag rgya sngags kyi bdag nyid che/ /de dang de yi las sgrub pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /dngos gcig la yang kun rtog pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs snang gyur te/ /grol dang sdug bsngal bde bskyed pa'i/ /las ni ma lus 21—1042

'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bas lus la sogs pa'i las/ /dge dang mi dge rtog las byung / /rtog pa kun las nges grol ba/ /ye shes las ni rtog de ci/ /dam tshig dag las bslang ba ni/ /don yod rdo rje'i 'khor lo bzang / /snying gar las kyi rdo rje khanyu// /bsams nas thams cad bdag dbang bskur/ /bla ma brnyas la sogs nyes pa/ /sbyin dang bcas pa'i mchod ston bya/ /phyi khrus rang gi 'khor lor gnas/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho gas bya/ /thun mtshams su yang mchod 1la sogs/ /bzlas pa snga ma bzhin du 3bya/ /snying gar 'khor lo mchog ④chud byas/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan pas nyal/ /ldang tshe dpal ldan lha mo yis⑤/ /glu blangs pas ni bskul bar bya/ /nang par langs nas sngar bzhin ni/ /legs zlos ⑥dang bo'i las can yin/ /ye shes cung zad babs gyur pas/ /sngags kyi tshul khrims brtul zhugs ldan/ /mig dang sku sogs byin kyis brlab/ /thun mtshams su ni rab bsgrims bzlas/ /rnam pa kun du rab rdzogs par/ /spro dang basbu ba byed pa po/ /ye shes dbang ba cung zad 'thob / /nyin mtshan rnal 'byor yang dag bsten/ /yang dag ye shes dbang thob bsgom/ /khams kyi rdul nang khams gsum mchog /gzugs brnyan bdag nyid sku can kyi/ /'gro ba'i don gyi hūṃbya ba byed/ /rnal 'byor mtshan ma dge ba yang / /du ma thob cing yang dag 'grub/ /de nyid gsum ni cho ga bzhinaske/ /mchod byas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rang ngam gzhan gyis bye gsol btab bam/ /gzhan don 'bad par byed pas kyang / /'khor lo la gnas tshul bzhin bzlas/ /mtshan ma thob nas yang dag bri/ /'khor lo can sngags 'bum bzlas sam/ /yang na rang gi lha yi 'bum/ /gzhan gyi khri ste 21—1043

yang na ni/ /'khor lo can gyi bkas gnang bri/ /'byin pa de nyid gsum dang spel/ /gzhan dag snying po'i sa bon spel/ /ming gi yi ge dang po ni/ /klad kor bcas pas sngags rnams btu/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rjer bshad/ /las chos 7chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /gsang gsum dam ①tshig phyag rgya yin/ /sa bon snying po yin par bshad/ /zhi la sogs pa rab bskul bas/ /las rnams byed pa rig par bshad/ /phreng ba'i sngags kyang rig skebashad de④/ /mkhas pas de rnams kun du bzla/ /ci rigs par ni bzlas byas dang / /rang bdag la sogs bka' thob bam/ /'gog pa'i 'khor lo goms pa yis/ /rang sems dag nas bri bar bya/ /ting 'dzin gsum po byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas la sogs lhag gnas bya/ /bgegs rnams bsal te phur bus gdab/ /bsang byugs sa la gsol ba gdab/ /mchod yon mchod dang gtor sbyin nas/ /sbyin sreg tshim byas mkha' la dgod/ /bgegs med sa ni brkos nas su/ /khung bu dgang ba'ang rim 'di yin/ /'jam rdo rje bdag rnal 'byor ldan/ /sngon du bsnyen pa rdzogs byas la/ /grogs dang mchod pa dang ldan par/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni yang dag sbyang / /bgegs dgra'i 'khor lo'i spyor la gnas / /rang gi dbang bskur yang dag blang / /de ltar gdug pa tshar gcad ༄pa/ /yang na rang lha'i sbyor bas bya/ /oṃ bhu khaṃ gi sngags kyis ni/ /sa ni nam mkhar 6gyur par bya/ /hūṃ lo hūṃ gis rdo rje'i bdag /sa byas de ni byin gyis brlab/ /oṃ me di nī badz+rī tsubha ba badz+ra brnya hūṃ/ sngar bzhin bgegs gzhom spyor ba'i bdag /bsnyen sogs rjes chags mthar thug pa'i/ /dang po'i sbyor ldan rang 'khor lo'ang / /rang byung bdud rtsi'i dru mthar thug de/ /21—1044

'khor lo'i rgyal mchog sbyor ba'i bdag /'khor lo'i las ni las mchog byed//las rgyal mchog gi sbyor ldan pas/ /ting 'dzin gsum po dam pa yin/ /de lta'i sbyor gnas slob dpon ni/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag lus can te/ /ngo bo nyid bdag rdo rje'i bdag /'khor lo'i sa gzhi dbus legs gnas/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin dpa' bo la/ /rdo rje dril mchog 'dzin pa'i grogs/ /rtag sogs bdag nyid gzugs can gyis/ /'khor gsum sprul la gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med med pa'i mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam spangs la—/ /kun du bzang po rmyesku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol—/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dam pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog 'khor los 5sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol//de nas 'gro khams mun nag bsten/ /'jam rgyal khros pas bltas pa ni/ /hūṃ brjod —tiṣ+ṭhas rang mig dang / /sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'degs chopar bya/ /yi ge ma ṭas nyi zla'i mig /phyogs dus thams cad sbar ba dang / /blo ldan 'gro la bltas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i sa ni yongs su bskor/ /rkang 'og rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje gsor bar thushin tu brtson/ /rol pa'i rdo rje 'gros kyi gar/ /mche ba gcigs bcas hūṃ sgrogs shing / /lha sogs bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rab gdug bgegs sogs bskrad par bya/ /lus ngag 21—1045

sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs ni thams cad nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs te/ /srung hūṃ ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /gal te bdag bsgom las 'das na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs ldan pas/ /sku gsum 'byung bas dgas bya ste/ /'jig kyepar 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /sa ni yongs su gzung 4byas nas/ /bgegs med phyir ni phur bu gdab/ /sngags phyal/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭhan phaṭa/ kri la thuya tī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ badz+ra shī la ya badz+ra dha ro ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra khri 3la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ smad du rtse gcig stod bgegs dgra/ /bsams nas dbus su phur bus gdab/ /phyogs bcu kun du gnas pa yi/ /bgegs tshogs thams cad gzhom par bya/ /sa ni kun du bgegs bral zhing / /'bar ba'i zer /mernos khyab bsams la/ /mtshams dang ra ba phyogs bcing ba/ /blos byas nas ni lhag gnas bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gye khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis khyebadud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /sa gzhi dri zhim sogs byugs shing / /me tog sna tshogs sil ma dgram/ /zla sogs 'khor lo can gnas su/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor rab tu bya/ /de la 'khor lo spyan drang ba/ /byas nas mtshams la sogs bcings te/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas nas/ /bum pa lhag par gnas par bya/ /mgrin pa gos mchog gis dkris la/ /a smra hūṃsogs 'dab kyis kha dgab/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi bum pa ni/ /de yi sngags kyis ⑫lhag gnas bya/ /'bru sman rin 21—1046

chen lnga rnams dang / /dri bzangs 2chu dang 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /me tog phreng btags rdo rje ni/ /steng bzhag 'khor lo'i gtso rgyal la/ /mchod yon phul te yang dag mchod/ /me tog dkar po gzhug par bya/ /der ni spos sogs dris zhu bsgos pa'i/ /pad snod dri bzangs co sogs ldan bya/ /nyin re bzhin du thun gsum du/ /gtor ma byin la de bzhin bzla47/ /de yang 'khor lo'i phyi mtshams su/ /rnam rgyal 'khor gco'i g.yas su'o/ /de las mchod yon snod du chu/ /bcug nas de yis dbang bskur na/ /bdag dang slob ma thams cad ni/ /chu yi dbang gis bskur bar 'gyur/ /slar yang 'khor lo mchod byas la/ /lag par bdug spos thogs nas ni/ /blo ldan pus btsugs 'khor lo'i gtso/ /bde gshegs rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed cag rnams la mchod pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don pyod/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang //gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang yang lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol//bdag ming 'di zhes bkyi ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'jam dpal 'byung ba ni/ /'gro ba dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'dri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa 21—1047

thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum de gsol gdab/ /gtso bo mchod la sogs byas te/ /yang dag bsrungs la phyir phyung nas/ /me tog phreng thogs rang slob ma/ /yid gzhungs spro ba che ba dang / /byas pa gzo zhing nga rgyal med/ /rigs mtho yon tan ldan zhing dang / /gzugs dang kha dog lang tshor ldan/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni/ /bsgrub la don gnyer mngon brtson na/ /gzugs ngan yon tan med pa'am/ /dman pa'ang lhag par gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga las/ /'khor bzhi char yang rjes su gnang / /rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan/ /jeg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /la la gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 17'bras bu rgyas/ /de skad brjod nas slob ma de/ /blo yis rang gi nang du gzhug /sngon bzhin rdo rje chu skyes kyis/ /dag /byas khyim sgor gsol ba 'debasake / /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas//slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan chopa/ /mgon bo chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i khrugrong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /slob ma 21—1048

des ni lan gsum brjod/ /rab gus bshes gnyen shes nas ni/ /slob ma gtso bo gcig la ni/ /dmigs bcas tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di—/ /khyed la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams—/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun gyis kyegasang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bshags sogs lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /de nas bla mas byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed pa ni bskyed par bya/ /bskyed pa slar yang dran du gzhug /las kun byed pas bsrungs nas ni/ /snying ga sgog ma spyi bo ru/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo dag /hūṃ āḥ.oṃ las de ru dgod/ /rdo rje spos chu khu tshur mchog /snying ga spyi bo sgog mar gtugs ze / /de bzhin hūṃ oṃ āḥbarjod bya/ /me tog la sogs rim bzhin sbyin/ /spyi bor me tog mdun du spos/ /mar me dri yang thugs ka ru/ /kun byed bzlas nas gus pa yisazhu —/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin par bya/ /a shwad u dusmra krur yi/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /ma yo ma gas srog chags med/ /rtse mor me tog bcas pa sbyin/ /shar ram byang du kha bltas bzhag /bcas nas ltos ④pa med par ni/ /ba ko tsam ni byug par dor/ /zhi la sogs pa'i dngos grub 21—1049

bstanalha/—/ /'thor 'thung skyor chu lan gsum blud/ /phyi rol du ni nges bzhag ste—/ /stan dang sngas phyir ku sha sbyin/ /dpung par skud pas bsrung bar bya/ /skyor chu lan gsum blud pa'i sngags/ /oṃ tweḥ ④bi shurnya dhas+thā ①sarba pā pa nish+tsa ④khru sho dha ya sarba thu bi kadze+e a pa na ya hūṃ/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ④ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ / bskal pa dubye ba du ma ru/ /sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas 'byang bar 'gyur lags na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod ④pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci 'tshal/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur—/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad⑨/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la spyod rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung shāste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /dzad rnams de ring dong bas na/ /rab byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /don bshad bsrung ba byas nas ni/ /ku sha'i stan la nyal du gzhug /rmi lam gang dag ci mthong ba/ /de kun 21—1050

nang par nga la zlos/ /srung dang byin rlabs sogs gang dag /der ni las kun byed pa bzla/ /rigs lnga 'khor lo gsum gyi ni/ /las kun byed pa thabs ①sbyor yin/ /rmi lam bzang ngan dris nas ni/ /mi dge thabs ②sbyor dag gis gzhom1/ /slob ma legs bsrungs skal ldan pa/ /de nas sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug /mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /stsal ④nas mgon po bdag la ni/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom phyedang gsang ba dam pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs—/ /slob ma slob dpon nyid don gnyer/ /sdom pa rnams kyang 'dzin du gzhug /rnal 'byor mnyam gzhag 'khor lo mchog /legs mchog blo yis mkha' la bzhag /rtag pa la sogs dngos 'dra zhing / /de mdog sa bon las byung ba/ /ye shes lnga ldan srad bu ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar rnam phye ba/ /dzaḥlas nyi ma zla ba'i mig /'jam pa'i rdo rje bdag gzugs kyis/ /'bar ba'i blta rjoba'i lcags kyus dgug /rang gi mdog ni nang du gzhug /rnam snang la sogs thugs ye shes/ /srad bu thams cad byed dang bcas/ /rang gi 'khor lo thig gdab phyir/ /rtag pa'i thig ni 30 du gsol/ /ji srid mi bskyod mthar thug pa/ /'di dag de nyid gsum dang spel/ /abyo t+yā ⑦nu ga ta sarba dharmā ⑧zhes bya sogs dran bya/ /chur ni 'khor lo'i nyis 'gyur la/ /sboms su sgo yi nyi shu'i cha/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed dri bzangs kyis⑨/ /sbangs ⑩ nas kyang ni bsrung bar bya/ /yig ⑪gsum chud par rnal 'byor pas/ /thig 'dzin pa dang bsgril bar bya/ /dz+dza gsum kyis ni de btang ⑫zhing / /rang yang 21—1051

dz+dza dz+dza dz+dza zhes zlos/ /khu tshur g.yon pas lte bar ni/ /bzung ste rmyenub dang lho phyogs gnas/ /blo ldan nam mkha'i thig gdab ste/ /de bzhin 'og tu thig rab gdab/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ nam mkha' gang ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ /khyod kyi 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /thig gi sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /de rnams 'dir bye ni gshegs su gsol/ /gnod sbyin yi dwags dbang po klu/ /phyogs bltas me dang rlung la brten/ /dang po shar dang nub byang lhor/ /phyogs kyi phyi rol srad bu gdab/ /me dang bden bral phyogs gnas te/ /mtshams kyi srad bu'ang yang dag gdab/ /shar lho nub byang de bzhin du/ /byas pas dkyil 'khor brgyad ⑪ du 'gyur/ /thig de nyis rim byas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i dbus su bzhag ④nas su/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa phyede rgyab tu/ /rdo rje'i srad bu gnyis bukyang gdab/ /dbang ldan las ni lcags ri dag /rang dang rjes mthun g.yas nas bskor/ /mkhas pas thig gis thig btab nas/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du bya/ /ltas ngan byung na dngos mi 'grub/ /srad bu chad na bla ma 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na na bar 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma myos par bye 'gyur/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa yi phyogs rnams thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab po/ /de yi nang gi 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa 'dra ba la/ /phyi yi 'khor lo'i byed kyi tshad/ /kun nas yongs su rlum por bya//ka ba 'khor lo la sogs spras/ /rdo rje phreng ba bzang pos bskor/ /de nas ṭī 21—1052

las khro bo yi/ /blta bas sgo ni rnam par dbye/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /kha khyer med pa nyid du 'dod/ /sgo khyud sgo yi tshad yin te/ /lha yi snam nyubu'ang de yi tshad/ /de phyed kha khyer kun nas bskor/ /logs zudang 'gram ni de bzhin te/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /dar sogs snam bu tshad de bzhin/ /tshon gyi sa ni de yi phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig sa'i phyi rol du'o/ /'khor lo la sogs ka ba'i thig /tshon gyi sa dang sa gzhi mnyam/ /rta babs sgo yi sum 'gyur te//ba dan phreng ba rnams dang ldan/ /dril bu mchog ni rlung gis bskyod/ /ba dan phyi yi mtshams su bya/ /gzhan dag 'khor lo'i rjes mthun par/ /ji ltar mdzes par rnam par brtags/ /rdzogs sangs ye shes sku yin phyir/ /chos sbu'i bdag nyid shin tu dag /gsung dbang rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /'di ni thugs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /sems can bsam rngupa la brten nas/ /tshad la sogs pa nges mdzad kyi/ /thabs shes las byung dngos grub la/ /tshad sogs nges pas ci zhig bya/ /de ni khru gcig nas brtsams te/ /ji srid khru stong bar du'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo ④de thig gdab/ /tshon la 'bar ba'i blta phya bas kyang / /snga ma'i rim gyis ye shes sbar/ /yang dag gzi bskyed gsang sngags bzla/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ /'di ni chos dbyengs dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni grol byed pa/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rab grol ba'o/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /bla mas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /mnyam zhing g.yas skor ⑥rgyun ma chad/ /ma yo bar 21—1053

ni tshon rtsi dgye/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha ru ni/ /ri mo mnyam par dgye bar bya/ /sbom por bkye bas nad kyis 'debs/ /phra mos nor ni rnam par 'jig /yon pos ①rnam 'gras chad zhu pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas skor ①min par bkye ba yis/ /tshon rtsi phur bus btab par 'gyur/ /dkar po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser la dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin te/ /de bzhin gzhan dag margad yin/ /nag po nang du shes bya ste//'di ni tshon gyi rim par bshad/ /dkar po chen po shar phyogs su/ /lho ru ser dang yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang dang yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi'i cha dag ni/ /in+d+ra nī la'i 'od gsal 'bar/ /rtag par shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag dulegs par bri/ /ri mo phan tshun nas gang gis/ /ma reg par ni bri bar bya/ /bdud rtsi thab ⑤sbyor rdo rje yis/ /gdug pa thams cad rnam par gzhom/ /'di ni rgya chen che bar bshad/ /gdug pa'i dgra ste gsang sngags rgyal/ /na maḥrjos masto kā ya bāka tsit+ta badzā t+t+waṃ/ na mo badz+ra gro dh+wa ya ma hā rdaskoṅka dūṭa hai ra ba ya a si mu sa la pa ra thushu pā sha hasta ya/ oṃ ⑨a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā nyi/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gadz+dza gadz+dza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyon bi nā ya kā na ma hā ga ṇa ⑩pa ti dzī bi tārnya ⑪ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ de ltar dkyil 'khor kun bris nas/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan byas te/ /ral gri sngo bsangs dbus bri ba/ /shin tu rnam dag sogs 'od ldan/ /shar du 'khor lo rtsibs ⑫brgyad mchog /me long la sogs yang dag 'bar/ /lho ru rin chen sngo bsangs 'od/ /cha dgu pa mtho ⑫mnyam pa nyid/ /nub tu pad+ma 21—1054

'dab brgyad pa/ /so sor rtog la sogs ldan dmar/ /byang du ral gri dam pa ni/ /bya ba la sogs kyis rab brgyan/ /shar lhor spyan de thabs yin la/ /lho nub rdo rje smon lam ste/ /nub byang kha ni bye ba yi/ /pad+ma sdong bu bcas pa stobs—/ /byang shar sa la ye shes te/ /ser dang sprin sngon lta bur mdzes/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi dang / /shar sgo yi ni ngos gnyis su/ /me long de bzhin pi wang dang / /dri yi dung dang bcud len snod/ /gos dang chos 'byung nyid dag ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs pas brgyan/ /dad sogs tho ba dbyig pa dang / /pad+ma rdo rje bzhi pa yin/ /rnam gsal kun+dar shes byas la—/ /rang gi 'khor lo rab gsal bsgom/ /sngar bzhin shes rab yang dag 'dug /sangs rgyas rnams ni rang nang gzhug /sems bzang nam mkha' khyab byas pa'i/ /'khor lo'i ngos su gnas bya'o/ /de dang lhan cig 'ongs pa'i bgegs/ /de ni kun bskrad mngon par bsrung / /gshin rje'i dgra sogs kyis bkug la/ /bcug ste bcings nas dbang du bya/ /mig dang sku sogs byin brlabs la/ /mchod yon dbang bskur mngon mchod pa/ /byas nas bstod de tshim bya zhing / /rnam bsgoms bzlas pas mnyes par bya/ /sngon bzhin pad snod dam par yang / /bdud rtsi ye shes bdud rtsir bya/ /phyogs skyong rang rang sbyor la gnas/ /rab tu mchod de dkyil 'khor 'jug /'jig rten gsum las rgyal gyur pas/ /gos dang rgyan ni ji snyed dang / /'khor lo bskor ba byas nas ni/ /phyag byas sbyin sreg dag gis mchod/ /kun nas sor bzhi dor bar du/ /kha khyer de'i tshad pad kha bye/ /khru phyed pa dang khru gang ba/ /'khor lo lta bu las kun byed/ /ral gri chu dang dpangs su ni/ /21—1055

sor brgyad sor gcig pa yi tshad/ /thab nang 'khor lo rin chen dang / /pad+ma ral gri dbus chud bri/ /phyi rol rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /sngags pa shar du kha bltas te/ /kun byed bzlas pas kun du bsrung / /mchod yon sogs g.yon de las gzhan/ /yo byad ①g.yas bzhag bsangs nas ni/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i 'byor gubadag ldan/ /'o ma can shing gis sbar ba'i/ /me ni yi ge gsum gyis bsang du/ /rlung yab g.yabs pas rab sbar la/ /g.yas nas bskor zhing ku sha dgram/ /dang po'i snying byung re ④gru gsum/ /pad gnas sa bon re las byung / /ser zhing zhal ser gsum pa la/ /shes rab yan lag rgyas 5dang ldan/ /spyi blugs mi 'jigs dbyig du pa phreng / /phyag na bsnams pa 'dir me bsam/ /sngar bzhin de nyid gsum 'don pas/ /ye shes dam pa'i me spyan drangs 3 / /de la bsang gtor la sogs pa/ /byas nas gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar yu ba khru/ /'og tu rdo rje rin chen bya/ /de steng dgang gzar rgyar skesor bzhi/ /zabs su sor gnyis nang rdo rje/ /sor bzhi'i mthar ni rdo rje ste/ /bar du pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs/ /blugs gzar pad+ma'i dbyibs sor gnyis/ /zabs su sor gcig nang rdo rje/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar khar ⑨rang gi/ /lha yi sa bon rab 'bar bsam/ /de'i khar yi ge re bkod la/ /de la dgang blugs sbyin par bya/ /me lha 'byor ldan yam shing ste/ /yam shing me la mar dang til/ /ma grugs drur ⑩ba 'bras chan zho/ /ku sha cho ga'i rim pa yin/ /de nyid ye shes dam pa'i me/ /thugs zlar rma skyes bdag po ni/ /'khor lo mchog bsams phyi mchod sogs/ /sngon du 'gro bas sbyin sreg bya/ /oṃ asna ye swā hā/ mar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ ⑪da 21—1056

ha na badz+ra ye sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ til gyi'o/ /badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/'bras ma grugs pa'i'o/ /oṃ sarba ①ā yu ṣe swā hā/ drur ④ba'i'o oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang 'bras chan gyi'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ①ya swā hā/ku sha'i'o/ /rgyas dang zhi dang dbang dgug bcing / /sdang dang bskrad dang mngon spyod la/ /oṃ swā hā hoḥdzaḥ④hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi mthar ni bskul ba'ang bya/ /rang bdag snying ga'i sems dpa' yi/ /lha kun tshim pa nyid du bya//zla sogs de las gzhan pa'i rdzas/ /snying zla'i 'khor lo'i ljags kyi mchog /bsgoms nas sngon bzhin tshim par bya/ /mthar ni de bzhin dgang blugs dbul//bsang dang 'thor 'thung mchod yon dag /phul nas mchod de gshegs su gsol—/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rdzas lhag ma/ /me la phul la de bzhin du/ /cho ga snga mas gshegs gsol la/ /'khor lo mchod de yang dag gzhug /slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga yis/ /dang por zhugs la rang gi ni/ /dbang bskur bya ba rdzogs byas shing / /rigs bdag rjes gnang thob pa dang / /'dod chags che las byung de nyid/ /'khor lo'ang gzugs brnyan lta bu yi/ /grong du slob ma 'jug bya'i phyir/ /bden pa 'di ni bsgrag par bya/ /nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer deng grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub spyochen po ste/ /dbang phyug ⑥chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal//mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis ⑦grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /21—1057

gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal pemachog gis/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje bsnyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun gyi snying ②khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la bzhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'o/ /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs dag ③dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /dzad kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /slob ma spyi buyi sdom pa dang / /sngon bzhin sku sogs 'od gsal bya/ /kun byed bum pa'i chu yis ni/ /yol ba'i mthar ni bsang gtor bya/ /de nas gos dmar gyis gdong g.yogs⑤/ /sdug pa khyod ni su zhes dri/ /de nas slob mas tshig tu ni/ /bdag ni skal ba bzang zhes brjod—/ /sgor ni phreng thogs rjoyang dag mchod/ /de bzhin yon ni phul ba dang / /rnal 'byor sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /snying gar rdo rje snying po bsam//sngags la oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pād yā ⑦mi su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ—/ deng byed de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dad pa dang mi ldan pa 21—1058

rnams la yang ma yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed sogs rang sngags ni/ /dam pas dgug dang gzhug par bya/ /yi ge lnga dang de bzhin du/ /brjod de dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ①ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis ④dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra shig /dam tshig nyams ④par gyur ta re/ de'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral dunas gshegs/ /pad gnas ⑤yi ge gsum gyis sbar/ /mi 'chi lnga pa 'thung du gzhug /'di ni dam tshig ④dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs ⑦na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /oṃ badzod ④ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ dam bca' ba brtan par 'di skad ces brjod do/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyi ⑨phyag na rdo rje ni nga yin gyis/ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de yang bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re zhes smras la/ de nas slob ma la 'di skad du/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis rlobs la rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig ces smyos shig par bsgo'o/ /de skad brjod nas de'i snying gar/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor mtshams su ni/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa kha dog ser/ /lo las byung ba'i hūṃ bsgom bya/ /baṃ byung chu ni kha dog dkar/ /21—1059

bum pas mtshan cing ①yongs su zlum/ /yo las byung ba'i g.yo ba'i rlung / /ba dan dngos mtshan gzhu yi dbyibs/ /de la sku gsung ha a bsgom ④/ /rkang 'og dz+nyo kyeni rab 'bar ba/ /rlung las ④ram̐ byung gru gsum par/ /gnas pas sbar la slob ma dbab/ /ā a+yo/be+e sha ya s+t+waṃ bha bye ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya/hūṃ ha a k+ṣiṃtsu/ lce la a ni dmar po zhig /bsams te babs la slar yang bsgo—/ /'dod chags rdo rje de gnas pa/ /sgros shig rdo rje dge mi dge/ /babs pa de ni brtan bya ba/ /de la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ /me tog phreng ba 'khor lor dor/ /pra tīts+tsha ④badz+ra ho zhes brjod/ /de ni spyi bor bcing bar bya/ /pra ti tsusnakṛṇ+ḍa twa mi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ blangs pa'am ma blangs pa gnyis ni/ /mtshan ma'am rngu mtshan ma nye ba ru⑪/ /babs sam dad kyang de'i sbyor ba/ /skal can nyid la sbyin par bya/ /mig tu 'bar bcas oṃ bsams la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /de nas 'khor lo bstan par bya/ /'khor lo'i bdag po nas brtsams ⑩te/ /bdud rtsi thab sbyor bar du'o/ /badz+ra a dzha ṣiñtsa zhes/ /brjod de spyi bor chus dbang bskur/ /sngon bzhin cod pan gyis rang bdag /lha yi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /snying gar rdo rje de 'dzin la⑫/ /rdo rje yis kyang dbang bskur bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod ni bskur bar 'gyur④/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab grub pa'i/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /rdo rje dril bus 'khyud nas ni/ /rang gi bdag pos dbang bskur sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti two a dzha ṣi.ā+oṃ ⑩mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ spyi bor ming gi ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ ⑫a bhi 21—1060

ṣispya rmyemi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye che ge mo rdo rje/ /rang gi dngos po gang gang snang / /gtso cher der ni 'jam rgyal rang / /chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gang yin derazu / /rang nyid 'khor los rngusgyur nyid pas/ /mtshan gyi ④thog mar dpal gyi sgra/ /kun la'ang bdag po thams cad las/ /kye dang rdo rje mtha' mar sbyar/ /chu khams dag pa mi bskyod pa/ /cod pan mnyam pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje so sor rtog mchog bdag /bdag po bya sgrub don sprul ba/ /ye shes rigs thuyin 'dir rdo rje/ /rgyu dang rigs kyi du dbang byas pa/ /brtul zhugs lung bstan dbugs 'byin pa/ /rigs dbang ④bskur la'ang 'di ming yin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ⑤two dha ra yā mi spu hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kun byin ⑩nas/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis 'dzin gzhug /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dril bu de nyid kyis bzung bak+ṣe / /chos kyi sgra yis ⑩dkrol du gzhug /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab sgra yi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag rmyetu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas rngubazhed/ /de chos kyis dgrol 8du gzhug ste/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag⑩ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'gal srid byas/ /rang bzhin gyis dag sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /bsnyen sogs snying por bshad pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen por byin brlabs la/ /gzugs sogs 21—1061

'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gsang sngags ma tshang ①med par bzla/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcur dus gsum bzhugs pa de/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yi/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi zad ②pa/ /bsten na mi snang mngon shes dang / /mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid—/ /las byung dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de bdag min/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten/ /ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can/ /sbyor bas bsgrubs na myur du 'grub/ /sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'grub/ /gang gzhan sman par bshad pa ni/ /sngags kyi ④bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pas so/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje gzung ④/ /chos kyi dril bu dgrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya cher//byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /zhes gang bshad pa de yi phyir/ /de skad ces bshad pa yin no/ /slob ma sdom pa gzung ⑤ba dang / /de bzhin yon ni phul ba yis/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol 'debs shing / /tshigs bcad 'dis kyang phyag bya'o/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas kyis/ /mchod chen ji ltar gsol ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab du pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'jug sgor pad+ma 'dab brgyad par/ /rang lha'i sbyor bas khri la gnas/ /dus gsum phyogs kun nam mkha' khyab/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rang snying byung / /rol mo dri la sogs ldan zhes/ /snga ma bzhin du rig dbang bskur/ /rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /tshigs bcad 21—1062
